hf.title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
hf.abstract: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.
hf.titleZh: S-Space：探索多模态语言模型中的空间工作区
hf.summaryZh: 多模态语言模型具备空间推理能力，但其内部机制此前并不清楚。研究定位出 S-Space——一个线性表示子空间，其中物体 token 表示沿水平、垂直、距离三个轴编码连续坐标，且该子空间为模型内生，在非空间问题下仍可读出。因果干预表明：感知将物体位置写入 S-Space，内部推理据此完成视角变换，语言回答只选择性读取它。作为诊断工具，S-Space 还暴露方位词中绝对参考系与图像相对参考系的系统性耦合，并指出瓶颈在跨视角的空间变换而非空间表征本身。
hf.reason: MLLM 空间推理的可解释性分析，机制清晰、因果证据扎实

hf.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
hf.abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 and 11.72 times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.
hf.titleZh: DiffusionART：高效、稳定且可扩展的扩散模型强化学习
hf.summaryZh: 在线强化学习可用黑盒奖励微调扩散模型，但反向过程方法（如 Flow-GRPO）因信用分配差而效率低，前向过程方法（如 DiffusionNFT）效率高却依赖精细调节的 EMA 离策略训练才能稳定。DiffusionART 指出 NFT 类目标隐含前向—反向一致性力，正负样本联合训练只能部分抵消，而 EMA 实际是通过「恢复」而非离策略 rollout 起稳定作用；方法把每个 prompt 的奖励聚合成共享的奖励改进方向，从构造上消除该一致性力，并加入信任域掩码的第二次更新实现漂移自适应恢复，无需 EMA 调参，也不需要可微奖励模型。在 HunyuanVideo-13B 上，达到 DiffusionNFT 与 Flow-GRPO-Fast 后期平均奖励水平所需 GPU 小时分别减少 12.02 倍和 11.72 倍，平均训练奖励高出 28.8% 和 53.0%。
hf.reason: 扩散模型 RL 微调，落在不关注的视觉生成方向

hf.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
hf.abstract: Humans effortlessly react to the world; they adeptly return a tennis shot, catch a falling cup, step aside from a passing cart, or pass a box tossed during truck unloading. These everyday actions require anticipating a moving target and reflexively responding with the whole body within about a second. Such visual reactive whole-body control remains challenging for humanoids, which must (1) coordinate whole-body control, (2) react to object dynamics in real time, and (3) ground perception in egocentric vision. We study catching thrown boxes as a representative task that demands all three capabilities; existing systems cover only part of it, relying on end-effectors, motion capture, or marked objects. We present Reflex, a three-stage framework that learns these capabilities stage by stage while connecting them through a compact representation of object dynamics. First, a state-based policy learns whole-body catching with reinforcement learning. Second, the policy learns to infer the dynamics of a moving box from delayed and incomplete observations. Third, an egocentric RGB-D encoder learns to recover this dynamics representation directly from visual observations while keeping the whole-body controller fixed. This decomposition provides each capability with a direct training signal and makes visual learning substantially more scalable. In simulation, Reflex achieves 85.7% catch success from egocentric RGB-D, compared with 87.9% when given privileged box observations. Temporal visual history is critical: removing it reduces success by 35.6 and 39.8 points on centered and laterally offset throws. On a real Unitree G1, Reflex catches human-thrown boxes with 65% and 40% success at 2.5 and 5 m, reaching 76% and 59% of human catchers' success at the same distances.
hf.titleZh: Reflex:视觉落地的反应式人形机器人控制
hf.summaryZh: 人形机器人要在约一秒内完成接住抛来的箱子这类全身反应式动作，需同时具备全身协调、实时跟随物体动力学以及以自我中心视觉完成感知落地的能力，而现有系统多依赖末端执行器、动作捕捉或带标记物体，只覆盖其中一部分。Reflex 用三阶段框架逐项学习这些能力，并以一个紧凑的物体动力学表征把三阶段串起来:先用强化学习训练基于状态的全身接物策略，再让策略从延迟且不完整的观测中推断箱子动力学，最后固定全身控制器、训练自我中心 RGB-D 编码器直接从视觉恢复该动力学表征，使每个能力都有直接训练信号且视觉学习更易扩展。仿真中，Reflex 仅凭自我中心 RGB-D 达到 85.7% 接住成功率，接近使用特权箱体观测的 87.9%;去掉时序视觉历史会使中心与侧向抛掷的成功率分别下降 35.6 和 39.8 个百分点。在真实 Unitree G1 上，2.5 米与 5 米抛掷的接住成功率为 65% 和 40%，相当于人类接球者同距离成绩的 76% 和 59%。
hf.reason: 人形机器人全身控制，属具身智能低分方向，仅沾 RL 与视觉表征边

hf.title: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
hf.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. Native application environments require substantial construction and integration effort, which limits application coverage and increases the risk of application-specific overfitting. Browser-hosted environments provide limited interaction depth and workflow complexity. These limitations motivate SoftwareGym, an automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI software environments with diverse interfaces, executable functionality, and runtime-verified behavior. It generates structurally diverse designs, realizes them as runnable applications, and uses GUI evaluation with iterative repair to ensure functional reliability. Using SoftwareGym, we synthesize 182 applications across twelve categories and achieve a mean GUI task pass rate of 91.5%. We construct SoftwareGym-Bench, a 120-task evaluation suite spanning the same twelve categories, and use trajectories collected from these environments for CUA training. The resulting model improves Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% on the strictly out-of-domain OSWorld benchmark and achieves 40.0% on SoftwareGym-Bench. These results demonstrate the potential of synthesized software environments as scalable and transferable supervision for CUA training.
hf.titleZh: SoftwareGym:用多样化合成软件环境扩展计算机使用智能体的训练
hf.summaryZh: 计算机使用智能体(CUA)训练缺乏大规模、可靠且多样化的软件环境:原生应用构建成本高且易导致过拟合，浏览器环境交互深度有限。SoftwareGym 提出自动化流水线，生成结构多样的 GUI 设计并落地为可运行应用，再通过 GUI 评估与迭代修复保证功能可靠性，共合成 12 类 182 个应用，平均 GUI 任务通过率 91.5%。基于这些环境收集的轨迹训练 CUA，在严格域外的 OSWorld 上 Pass@3 从 41.39% 提升至 56.97%，在自建的 120 任务 SoftwareGym-Bench 上达 40.0%，说明合成软件环境可作为可扩展、可迁移的监督信号。
hf.reason: Agent 环境合成与 CUA 训练，命中 Agent 及环境合成方向

hf.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
hf.abstract: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.
hf.titleZh: EmbodiedCLBench:评估自进化具身智能体的持续学习能力
hf.summaryZh: 针对持续学习研究长期局限于非具身环境的问题，提出 EmbodiedCLBench——首个在具身仿真中评估自进化智能体持续学习能力的 benchmark，以组合泛化为核心原则，考察智能体能否先从基础任务中学习、再重组已获得的技能解决未见过的高级任务。实验覆盖多种 agent harness 与学习方法:零样本下高级任务几乎无法完成，但基础任务经验能带来稳定提升且不随任务复杂度增加而衰减;然而该提升不随学习样本数量扩展，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有效信息。结果说明持续学习是自进化具身智能体尚未充分探索的基础能力。
hf.reason: 持续学习与自进化智能体评测，命中 Agent 与评测方向，但具身场景偏边缘

hf.title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
hf.abstract: Multimodal large language models have become the dominant paradigm for visual understanding, but incur substantial costs by encoding inputs into dense, fixed-size patch tokens. However, visual information is unevenly distributed: some regions require fine-grained detail, while others admit compact representations. Downsampling sacrifices this detail, while existing token pruning and adaptive approaches remain limited in content-adaptive granularity, task generalization, and integration with modern MLLMs and serving infrastructure. Overcoming these limitations calls for foundation models that learn, end to end, where-and at what granularity-to allocate visual representations, a native capability we term elastic visual representation weaving. We introduce VisionWeave, establishing this capability in frontier-level MLLMs through large-scale training. It combines two components: a gated spatial pooler constructs coarse-grained representations alongside native fine-grained representations within a shared MRoPE coordinate, while a granularity router learns their content-adaptive allocation. Through self-distillation alone, we validate this capability on Qwen3.5-4B and scale to Qwen3.8-27B with over 30K A100 GPU-hours. Based on Qwen3.8-27B, VisionWeave adaptively adjusts token savings to visual content, saving 43.0% tokens on average while retaining 98.9% native performance across eight benchmarks, versus only 88% performance preserved for token pruning baselines with a fixed 50% savings target. Extensive evaluations confirm robust efficiency-quality trade-offs across diverse tasks, resolutions and video frames. When deployed on SGLang serving engine, our method achieves a 2.3x throughput gain while reducing mean TTFT by 54.4% and mean TPOT by 60.6%. Together, we believe these results position elastic visual weaving as a promising capability for next-generation multimodal models.
hf.titleZh: VisionWeave:将弹性视觉表示编织为 MLLM 的原生能力
hf.summaryZh: 多模态大模型把图像统一编码为稠密定长 patch token，计算开销大，而视觉信息实际分布不均。VisionWeave 让模型端到端学会「在哪里、以何种粒度」分配视觉表示:门控空间池化器在共享 MRoPE 坐标下生成粗粒度表示并与原生细粒度表示共存，粒度路由器按内容自适应分配。基于 Qwen3.8-27B、逾 3 万 A100 小时训练后，在八个 benchmark 上平均省 43.0% token 且保留 98.9% 原生性能，固定 50% 剪枝基线仅保留 88%;部署到 SGLang 后吞吐提升 2.3 倍，平均 TTFT 降 54.4%、TPOT 降 60.6%。适用于高分辨率图像与视频推理的降本增效场景。
hf.reason: MLLM 视觉 token 弹性分配，架构与效率双命中，实验扎实

hf.title: Hear the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
hf.abstract: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.
hf.titleZh: 在立体声中听见世界:学习动态空间对应以实现沉浸式联合视频-音频生成
hf.summaryZh: 针对联合视频-音频生成普遍忽略立体声、难以满足 AR/VR 与交互游戏沉浸感需求的问题，提出 StereoBind:以运动轨迹为纽带，通过视觉运动绑定建立源感知的音视频对应，用空间轨迹编码器刻画声源绝对位置，并以残差轨迹 RoPE 建模相对运动，使感知声位随对应视觉源的运动一致演化。同时构建带配对运动轨迹的大规模立体声音视频数据集 StereoWorld-29K 与空间一致性评测基准 StereoWorldBench。实验表明，该方法在保持整体音视频质量的同时，显著优于现有模型的立体声空间对齐效果。
hf.reason: 立体声视频-音频联合生成，属低分方向，仅数据集与评测略沾边

hf.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
hf.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.
hf.titleZh: ProgramGym:面向长时程程序复现 Agent 的可扩展训练环境
hf.summaryZh: 针对编码 Agent 从零构建程序(而非修仓库 bug 或按需求文档生成代码)时缺乏可扩展、可验证训练环境的问题，ProgramGym 给出 Program-Env 与 Program-Agent 两部分:Program-Env 用反馈驱动循环修复运行时沙箱构建与黑盒测试质量，从真实仓库自动构造出覆盖 C、C++、Go、Rust 的 1,648 个训练环境;Program-Agent 把分析、实现、评审拆成角色隔离的工作流，并加入编译检查与失败恢复的版本管理。在 ProgramBench 上，用这些环境微调使 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.87% 升至 42.84%,Program-Agent 再把基座与 SFT 模型推到 55.71% 和 56.25%，超过部分旗舰模型。
hf.reason: 编码 Agent 训练环境合成与长时程工作流，直接命中 Agentic RL 方向

hf.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
hf.abstract: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill.
hf.titleZh: Work2Skill：捕获人类 GUI 经验以实现可复用的 Agent 技能归纳
hf.summaryZh: 计算机操作 Agent 在陌生软件与依赖人类领域知识的工作流上仍表现不佳；人类演示含过程性知识，复用却需在上下文中解读动作并分离工作流规则与任务细节。WorkRecorder 同步采集屏幕录制、鼠标键盘事件与 accessibility tree，据此构建 WorkDemo-350——首个面向技能归纳的同步多模态桌面 GUI 演示数据集（350 条）。配套的 agentic 技能归纳方法按需检视证据，产出含工作流规则、步骤依赖与完成校验的可复用技能。四个执行模型配备该技能后得分与成功率最高：MyPCBench Bounded Action 较 No Skill 基线平均提升 4.67–10.54 分，OSWorld-Verified 的 286 任务子集提升 3.11–7.50 分。
hf.reason: GUI Agent 技能归纳，数据集加 agentic 方法，命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
hf.abstract: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. Coupled with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, this provides the high-quality supervision small models require without breaking their original distribution. Evaluations spanning 4 acquisition datasets (including a mixture) and 14 retention benchmarks show SynthSelf consistently outperforms 6 methods (including off- and on-policy distillation) across 3 small model scales. Extensive further analyses confirm SynthSelf paves the way toward effective small-model continual learning.
hf.titleZh: 通过合成自蒸馏实现小模型的持续后训练
hf.summaryZh: 小模型持续后训练面临「学新」与「保旧」的两难:自蒸馏微调(SDFT)靠上下文示例做自监督来缓解遗忘，但依赖强上下文学习与指令遵循能力，在小模型上失效。作者发现习得差与遗忘程度和后训练模型的分布偏移呈线性相关，由此提出 SynthSelf，把 SDFT 的分布内改写外包给同族、仅略大的 aligner 生成合成监督，并配合 off-policy 监督与拒绝采样，在不破坏原始分布的前提下提供小模型所需的高质量监督。在 4 个习得数据集(含混合集)与 14 个保持能力基准上，SynthSelf 在 3 种小模型规模下稳定优于包括 off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏在内的 6 种方法，为端侧低延迟场景的持续学习提供了可行路径。
hf.reason: 小模型持续后训练+合成自蒸馏，命中后训练与蒸馏方向

hf.title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
hf.abstract: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/
hf.titleZh: SepGen:单模型中的多音轨音视频分离与生成
hf.summaryZh: 4D 音视频场景的新视角渲染要求每个声源都有独立波形，便于定位与传播后再混合，而现有联合音视频生成器只输出不可分离的混音。SepGen 扩展预训练音视频生成器，单次联合采样即同时输出视频、混音与每个带标注声源的独立音轨，并支持两种模式:生成模式由声源描述决定各音轨内容(如双人对话按原轮次各出一条音轨)，分离模式保持输入混音不变、由描述指定要抽取的内容。在文本合成场景、其他生成器渲染的场景以及真实语音、音乐、音效录音上评测，给出台词描述时优于语言条件分离器，语音上优势最明显，移除台词后仍保持领先。
hf.reason: 音视频生成与音源分离，属低分方向，与 LLM 仅弱相关

hf.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
hf.abstract: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate completedmodels model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
hf.titleZh: AI 智能体能否一路「学」上巅峰？在长期游戏智能体竞赛中评估启发式学习
hf.summaryZh: 针对有限样本下策略学习与适应困难的问题，将 AI 智能体用作学习引擎，在冻结模型权重的前提下改写可执行策略与配套软件，形式化为对抗式启发式学习（AHL）；并构建 AAArena，含 12 个真实对抗游戏与 1920 份人类存档程序，按真实赛事协议在固定对局与评估预算下考察规则理解、对手选择、复盘分析与策略改写。Opus5.5 搭配 Claude Code 获 6 枚金牌，其余 6 个人类排行榜无一配置登顶，规则越复杂表现越弱；对手选择与稠密反馈促进策略改进，自身对局与对手对局回放（on-/off-policy）均带来增益。
hf.reason: Agent 自改进与长期竞赛基准，贴近 Agentic RL，但限于游戏域

hf.title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
hf.abstract: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.
hf.titleZh: SoloQ:面向扩散语言模型的免校准量化
hf.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)全序列去噪需反复前向，块扩散还引入 KV cache，推理开销高;而现有训练后量化依赖校准数据，激活分布却随掩码状态与去噪步数漂移。SoloQ 提出免校准框架:用结构化 K-RPBH 旋转把权重与激活映射到边际分布可预测的归一化旋转基，辅以轻量重缩放校正，既支持分布匹配码本也支持硬件原生 NVFP4;对块扩散模型则采用提交时刻的 KV cache 量化，压缩持久状态而不扰动正在去噪的块。在 LLaDA、Dream、Fast-LLM v2 与 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 上，4-bit 下精度保持并优于校准基线，NVFP4 峰值内存最多降 2.61 倍、端到端推理加速最高 2.24 倍。
hf.reason: 量化与 KV cache 命中效率方向，但扩散语言模型按画像一刀切低分

hf.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
hf.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
hf.titleZh: RSI-Anything：用世界模型解锁递归自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 递归自我改进要把交互经验转为持久能力，但外部反馈昂贵，策略演化也会让世界模型预测失准。RSI-Anything 基于 JEPA-Anything 的领域通用框架，用预测世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择，观测反馈驱动策略或工作流改进并适配世界模型，兼容性检查决定保留哪些策略-模型对。代码修复成功率从静态验证 26.3% 升至预测选择 29.2%、适配后 31.2%,GUI 平均动作减少 39.4%;五版策略内实验室规划从 21.80% 升至 46.01%;反应优化 40 次实验预算下最优产率 96.15%，高于贝叶斯优化 82.16%。
hf.reason: 世界模型驱动的递归自我改进，系统性强，命中自进化方向

hf.title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
hf.abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.
hf.titleZh: PolyOCR-Venus：面向文本中心视觉智能的统一 OCR 基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 现有 OCR 系统往往只擅长部分任务，难以在识别、解析与推理之间取得平衡。PolyOCR 系列统一 OCR 基础模型采用共享的指令跟随框架，配合将异构视觉资源转化为质量校验监督信号的大规模数据引擎，并提出 Competence-Guided Policy Optimization：把基于验证器的 GRPO 与按教师可靠性、师生能力差距做样本级路由的 on-policy 蒸馏结合。团队还修订出 OCRBench v2.1，修正标注并采用任务对齐评分。在 OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部 KIE、OmniDocBench v1.6 与 MDPBench 上取得 SOTA 或极具竞争力的结果。
hf.reason: 统一 OCR 基础模型，GRPO 结合 on-policy 蒸馏，命中后训练与多模态方向

hf.title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
hf.abstract: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.
hf.titleZh: 学习表征以引导像素扩散 Transformer
hf.summaryZh: 论文考察外部视觉表征在像素扩散 Transformer 中的生成效用，发现表征质量更高并不等于生成效果更好:像素合成过程会逐步丢失外部对齐的语义，而把像素解码器从架构上分离也只是重新分配语义与空间建模能力。为此提出表征引导(RG)，在保持朴素 Transformer 架构的前提下，用低维瓶颈把与生成相关的信息压成紧凑内部表征，再按其诱导的预测偏移修正 flow-matching 目标，显式引导解码器生成。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，仅 459M 参数的 RG-L/16 即超过更大的像素扩散 Transformer,RG-XL/16 取得 FID 1.55,512×512 下 FID 1.74，并扩展到文生图，GenEval 0.89、DPG-Bench 87.1。
hf.reason: 像素扩散图像生成方向，属不关注的扩散/生成类

hf.title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Draftsfor Speculative Decoding
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. Recent diffusion-based drafters make this paradigm particularly attractive: deep attention-based neural backbones provide strong predictions, while drafting multiple future positions in parallel avoids the sequential cost of autoregressive generation. This parallelism, however, comes at a cost. Tokens within a draft block are predicted without access to the realized identities of preceding draft tokens, removing intra-block dependencies that would naturally be available under autoregressive generation. We introduce DCOCO (DFlash Contextual Corrector), a lightweight mechanism that restores these dependencies while preserving parallel drafting. Rather than committing to each position's top prediction, DCOCO retains multiple candidate tokens and evaluates their contextual compatibility across adjacent draft positions in parallel, enabling contextually informed token selection at low additional cost. Across four verifier backbones and ten benchmarks, DCOCO achieves the highest average throughput in every evaluated configuration, spanning greedy and stochastic decoding with and without extended reasoning, with speedups of up to 6.6x over vanilla decoding. Its advantage persists under concurrent serving: DCOCO outperforms the strongest competing method by 6-23% across 4-32 concurrent requests, while other sequential correctors fall below uncorrected DFlash at these loads. These results demonstrate that recovering intra-block dependencies through parallel contextual scoring delivers consistent acceleration across decoding regimes and serving loads.
hf.titleZh: 投机解码中并行草稿的上下文校正
hf.summaryZh: 针对扩散式起草器并行预测草稿块时看不到前序草稿 token、丢失块内依赖的问题，提出轻量机制 DCOCO:不直接提交每个位置的最高预测，而是保留多个候选 token，并行评估相邻起草位置之间的上下文兼容性，以低成本完成上下文感知的 token 选择。在四个验证模型与十个基准上，贪婪与随机解码、含扩展推理的设置中平均吞吐均为最优，相对普通解码最高加速 6.6×;在 4–32 并发请求下比最强竞品高 6–23%，而其他串行校正方法在高负载下甚至低于未校正的 DFlash。为并行起草恢复块内依赖、提升高并发服务吞吐提供了低成本可插拔方案。
hf.reason: 投机解码加速，直接命中高效推理方向且评测扎实

hf.title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
hf.abstract: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository's existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.
hf.titleZh: SWE-Duel：迈向代码智能体的自扩展竞技场
hf.summaryZh: 静态代码基准一经发布即固定，任务会泄漏进训练数据，也终将被更强智能体饱和。SWE-Duel 把基准做成自扩展竞技场：两个代码智能体以红蓝镜像回合互为出题者与解题者，红方在真实仓库中实现新功能并植入隐蔽 bug 与密封触发测试，PR 需同时通过功能测试、仓库既有测试且恰好失败于 bug 测试，还须由同一智能体的新会话盲修成功才被接纳，蓝方则在不知有 bug 的前提下评审修复。在 11 个模型-harness 组合、15 个仓库、5 种语言、1500 回合的锦标赛中，GPT-5.5+Codex CLI 修复了 98.3% 的缺陷居首，Claude Opus 4.8+mini-swe-agent 以 27.3% 红方胜率成为最强出题者；同族最新版本模型所出任务击败固定解题者的比例达 42.9%（旧版本仅 4.0%），初步显示任务难度随出题能力同步扩展。
hf.reason: 代码智能体自扩展对抗评测，命中 Agent 与评测方法学

hf.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
hf.abstract: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
hf.titleZh: InstantFusion:面向异构图像生成器的共享隐空间接口
hf.summaryZh: 独立训练的扩散/流模型在隐空间组织上高度相似，直接传递中间去噪状态也能保留粗略视觉内容，但跨模型的隐表征对齐与去噪动态一致性仍缺乏系统研究。InstantFusion 为异构图像生成器构建轻量共享隐空间接口:用各模型专属的 Latent AutoEncoder(LAE)把中间状态投影到共享空间，再解码到目标生成器的隐空间，并以「同一图像、匹配噪声水平的中间状态对齐」与「局部去噪速度同步」两个目标约束该空间。训练完成后，去噪过程可在冻结的生成器之间无缝切换，无需为每一对模型单独训练映射;在采样加速、多偏好组合、跨架构 on-policy 蒸馏与跨模型组合等场景均取得有竞争力的结果。
hf.reason: 扩散图像生成方向，属低分清单，仅蒸馏环节稍有擦边

hf.title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
hf.abstract: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.
hf.titleZh: 无状态语言智能体:扩展长时程自动化研究
hf.summaryZh: 长时程自动化研究中的 LLM 智能体常陷入重复回放历史、彼此重复劳动、token 持续消耗却不再推进的困境，而短预算评测掩盖了这些失效模式。为此提出无状态语言智能体(SLA):由 harness 持有研究状态(候选解与实测结果)，智能体不在多次调用间携带对话，每次调用重建角色专属的新上下文，无状态 Advisor 读取跨搜索方向的证据摘要并向并行 Worker 派发具体实验。在软件工程、kernel 优化与算法设计上以最高十亿 token 预算评测，SLA 每项任务均取得最佳最终结果，并以减少逾 84% 的 token 达到最强 kernel 基线的最终性能，Advisor 自身消耗不足 0.6% 的 token。
hf.reason: 长时程科研智能体新范式，系统性强，直接命中 Agent 与 AI for Research

hf.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
hf.abstract: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.
hf.titleZh: 面向智能体持续学习的循环式 harness
hf.summaryZh: 现有 agent harness 的演化通常只靠前向信息流，或需要额外的回放与验证数据来优化，难以在严格在线流式协议下适应分布偏移。ReHarness 在每条实例结束后，把该实例产生的轨迹作为反馈，反向修正当初为该实例检索到的反思内容，使反馈沿文本 harness 状态向后传播。在三个持续学习基准与三个语言模型骨干上，它稳定优于原始上下文基线、基于记忆与反思的方法以及 prompt 优化方法。分析显示其修正有来源依据、能纠正分布偏移下过泛化或过时的经验，并同时改善持续学习中的稳定性与可塑性。
hf.reason: Agent harness 在线持续学习，反向修正文本状态，直接命中 Agent 与自我改进方向

hf.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.
hf.titleZh: 从仅结果奖励的强化学习中诱导过程监督
hf.summaryZh: 过程奖励模型(PRM)的步骤级反馈对后训练与测试时推理很关键，但人工步骤标注难以扩展，蒙特卡洛估计又昂贵且易偏离步骤本身的对错。TIPS提出仅结果奖励的强化学习框架训练生成式PRM:模型先生成思维链，再输出步骤级标签与结果标签，奖励只取决于结果预测是否正确，组相对优势据此优化整段生成，从而在无显式过程监督下强化步骤校验。在数学与Agent基准及四个基座家族上，TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507只用3.2K条结果标注轨迹即在ProcessBench达到85.2 F1，超过所有对比的已训练PRM与GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus等prompt judge，仍落后o1-mini。
hf.reason: 仅结果奖励RL训练PRM，直接命中后训练与可验证奖励方向

hf.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
hf.abstract: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
hf.titleZh: 迈向物理落地的铰接式 3D 资产：多智能体流水线与基准
hf.summaryZh: 目标是让生成的铰接式 3D 资产不仅外观像，还要在物理上成立：能无碰撞运动、在重力下稳定，并具有正确的质量与材质属性。Artisan 在 Articraft 基础上引入带物理仿真反馈的多智能体流水线，并构建覆盖空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务表现与整体质量四方面的统一基准，包含 ArtVIP/LightWheel 的 100 个参考资产、50 条稳定性提示与 50 个带参考质量的 ABO 物体。对 10 余个代表性模型的评测显示，Artisan 在保持有竞争力的空间保真度同时取得最低碰撞率与最高稳定率。该工作为 3D 生成走向物理可用、功能可用的资产提供了系统与评测两方面的基础。
hf.reason: 铰接式 3D 资产生成与仿真，属视觉重建与图形学，偏离 LLM 方向

hf.title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
hf.abstract: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.
hf.titleZh: MetaKernelBench:测量超越代码的 GPU 内核知识迁移
hf.summaryZh: GPU 内核优化 Agent 常把经验蒸馏为技能，但现有内核基准只评单次实现的正确性与速度，不衡量留存经验的复用价值。MetaKernelBench 用 74 个融合子图问题(六类家族)，每个以仅 DSL 不同的 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 成对变体呈现:模型先单独求解一个变体并蒸馏出自然语言技能，再以该技能为唯一额外输入去解另一 DSL 的同一问题，在匹配预算下与 solo 尝试对比。六个模型双向的配对提升为 -19% 到 +29%，四个模型双向为正，但各方向仍有 16% 到 45% 的问题回退;提升取决于源尝试相对目标 solo 的优劣，而非源尝试是否成功。
hf.reason: GPU 内核跨 DSL 技能迁移基准，命中代码智能与 Agent 评测方向

hf.title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
hf.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become increasingly popular for transferring teacher capabilities to student models. In this work, we ask a critical research question: Is on-policy sampling always beneficial for distilling arbitrary teacher-student pairs? We show that a simple alternative, Semi-OPD, which distills from offline rollouts generated by the initial student, can often outperform OPD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Across 17 teacher-student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4x training speedup. We further find that the choice between OPD and Semi-OPD depends on the alignment between the initial teacher and student, quantified by an output-token overlap ratio: OPD is beneficial only when the two are highly aligned with high overlap ratios. Our deeper investigation suggests that effective distillation requires on-policyness w.r.t. both the student and the teacher. For misaligned pairs, student rollouts can become increasingly off-policy w.r.t. the teacher as context length grows, weakening the distillation signal. In contrast, Semi-OPD is often more stable, as it distills on shorter contexts while covering full trajectories and exposing the student to more teacher-preferred tokens. Beyond proposing Semi-OPD as an efficient alternative, our work motivates the community to rethink when to use OPD and to study stronger OPD variants with meaningful teacher-student pairs.
hf.titleZh: 我们何时需要 On-Policy 蒸馏?在离线学生 rollout 上蒸馏往往更好
hf.summaryZh: 质疑 on-policy 蒸馏(OPD)是否总优于离线采样:提出 Semi-OPD，直接在初始学生模型生成的离线 rollout 上蒸馏，省去持续采样。在1.5B到235B的17组 teacher-student 组合中，Semi-OPD 有14组超过 OPD，准确率最高提升13.6%，训练加速最多11.4倍。研究进一步用输出 token 重叠率刻画初始师生对齐度:仅当对齐度很高时 OPD 才占优;错位时学生 rollout 随上下文变长对教师越来越 off-policy，蒸馏信号被削弱，而 Semi-OPD 在更短上下文上覆盖完整轨迹、暴露更多教师偏好 token，因而更稳定。该工作为蒸馏数据来源的选择给出可操作判据，提示社区重新审视 OPD 的适用条件。
hf.reason: 蒸馏策略再思考，给出对齐度判据，直接命中后训练方向

hf.title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
hf.abstract: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.
hf.titleZh: 在潜在空间中评判：通过语义保持压缩实现高效生成式奖励建模
hf.summaryZh: 奖励建模需同时表示并推理多个评估标准，而逐token显式生成评判过程推理开销可观。LatentGRM以语义分块、压缩与重建构建潜在评估框架，用rubric引导的评估结构指导压缩，学得紧凑连续轨迹直接完成成对判断，不生成文本评判；另设interpreter从轨迹重建评估文本，离线查看压缩保留的信息。在与显式SFT judge同等数据与骨干下，4B与8B规模偏好准确率相当；8B在四个benchmark域将评估轨迹压缩8.9–9.2倍，vote@5总推理时间降低6.1–7.0倍，受控rubric干预表明标准相关偏好信息随潜在序列传递。
hf.reason: 奖励建模结合潜在推理压缩，命中RLHF与推理效率方向

hf.title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
hf.abstract: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
hf.titleZh: DataVista:诊断多模态大模型的数据视频理解能力
hf.summaryZh: 数据视频把数据可视化与视频叙事融为一体，是新闻报道和商业分析中的常见形态，但已有 benchmark 要么针对通用视频、要么只覆盖静态图表，数据视频理解一直缺少系统评测。DataVista 构建了首个数据视频理解基准，含 961 个真实数据视频与 6775 道评测题，按数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解三级递进能力框架组织，覆盖 10 类细粒度题型与五个主题领域。对 19 个主流 MLLM 的系统评测显示，表现最好的 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率仅 70.0%，远低于人类专家，其中因果推理与叙事结构最弱;增加采样帧数和补充字幕主要提升数据感知与时序推理，对叙事理解帮助有限。该基准可作为多模态大模型在动态图表与叙事理解方向的诊断工具，并给出了图表读取、证据判断、指令理解三类典型失败模式。
hf.reason: MLLM 多模态评测基准，命中多模态理解与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
hf.abstract: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. Motivated by these findings, we propose entropy and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor hidden-state sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant. As part of this framework, we introduce token-entropy filtering, which removes hidden states associated with low predictive-entropy tokens, thereby improving the quality of layer-selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, our selected sets outperform fixed baseline choices, including the default [2, N//2, N-3] rule, while providing a clearer explanation of why some defaults can remain competitive. Our results provide a practical recipe for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding, insights into the geometry and information in LLM decoder states, and a foundation for extending similar analysis to related applications.
hf.titleZh: 冲浪激活波:分析 LLM 隐藏状态的信息与几何以用于投机解码
hf.summaryZh: 现有投机解码方法多依赖固定位置启发式(如 [2, N//2, N-3])挑选目标模型的少数层，而最优层子集本质是组合优化问题，穷举不可行。本文提出基于两条互补准则的多层隐藏状态选择框架:以矩阵熵衡量信息量，以中心化核对齐(CKA)衡量多样性;通过分析逐层 Shannon 熵、隐藏状态拼接后的聚合熵以及逐对 CKA 随深度的变化，揭示解码器表示中的信息与几何分区。在此基础上给出熵与 CKA 驱动的层选择算法，并引入 token 熵过滤剔除低预测熵 token 以提升统计质量。在 EAGLE3 式投机解码中，所选层组合优于固定基线，同时解释了默认规则的竞争性来源。
hf.reason: 投机解码层选择，信息论与 CKA 分析扎实

hf.title: MixTok: Adaptive Visual Tokenization with Global 1D Tokens and Sparse 2D Refinement
hf.abstract: Efficient visual tokenization requires balancing representation compactness with the preservation of fine-grained image content. Conventional grid-based tokenizers allocate tokens uniformly across spatial locations despite non-uniform visual complexity, whereas compact 1D tokenizers aggregate global information but can struggle to preserve local details. We introduce MixTok, a hybrid visual tokenizer that combines a compact 1D global representation with sparse 2D tokens for local refinement. A content-adaptive router ranks candidate locations by refinement priority and determines the number of 2D tokens for each image under a target average token budget. At the highest-scoring locations, 2D token features replace the spatial features recovered from the 1D representation, and a shared decoder reconstructs the image from the resulting mixed features. On ImageNet 256 x 256, MixTok achieves highly competitive reconstruction and generation performance, with an rFID of 1.195 and a gFID of 1.95 at respective average budgets of approximately 128 and 131 content tokens per image.
hf.titleZh: MixTok:结合全局 1D Token 与稀疏 2D 精修的自适应视觉分词
hf.summaryZh: 针对传统网格分词器在空间上均匀分配 token、紧凑 1D 分词器又难以保留局部细节的问题，提出混合视觉分词器 MixTok:以紧凑的 1D 全局表示承载整体信息，由内容自适应路由器按精修优先级对候选位置排序，并在平均 token 预算下决定每张图所需的 2D token 数量，在得分最高的位置用 2D 特征替换由 1D 恢复的空间特征，再由共享解码器从混合特征重建图像。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，平均约 128 与 131 个内容 token 时分别取得 1.195 的 rFID 与 1.95 的 gFID，重建与生成性能具竞争力。
hf.reason: 视觉分词服务于图像重建与生成，与关注方向仅轻微擦边

hf.title: GraphDecisionBench: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.
hf.titleZh: GraphDecisionBench：对图任务上的 System One 模型进行基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 针对 System One 类模型（如 Jev）在图理解与决策任务上能力不明的问题，提出模型无关基准 GraphDecide，通过结构化任务画像、匹配的图-文输入对照与启发式提议控制来诊断图决策表现。在 14 种模型-接口配置上评测 Jev 及相关选择式模型与语言模型基线，发现邻接识别准确并不保证结构正确性、图文联合输入未必提升预测、可行构造也不等于高解质量。其任务契约、候选接口与评分规则支持原生选择器与语言模型适配器之间的横向比较。
hf.reason: 图任务基准，属评测方法学但选题较窄，分量有限

arxiv.title: A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: In humans, proprioception corresponds to the sense of self-movement or position, e.g. understanding the position of one's arm. This sense is often less well-understood and in popular understanding sometimes conflated with introspection. But, notably, proprioception is a separate sense, with dedicated receptors and verifiable outcomes. On the other hand though, language models cannot observe their own internal states during training (and for example answer the question which experts activated in a certain layer of an MoE) and so cannot accurately report on them. Yet, such information is, by virtue of being internal to the model, both accessible, and readily constructed into verifiable signals. We argue that this provides the basis for a digital analog of proprioception. As such, we train models through SFT and on-policy training to equip them with this ability. We show that modern models can be trained to understand a range of subtypes of proprioception, such as routing decision awareness, token entropy, decision depth or logit lens information, without affecting model capabilities. We then run these models through a broad evaluation of situational awareness, legibility, and epiphenomenality, to evaluate in what ways access to proprioception changes model behavior.
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型中的本体感觉
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型无法在训练过程中观测自身内部状态，因而难以准确报告 MoE 专家路由、token 熵、logit lens 等信息。论文主张这类内部信息天然可及且可构造为可验证信号，据此提出数字版「本体感觉」，用 SFT 与 on-policy 训练让模型学会识别路由决策、token 熵、决策深度等多种子类型。实验显示模型能掌握这些能力且不损害原有性能，并从情境感知、可读性与副现象性三方面评估该能力如何改变模型行为。
arxiv.reason: 内部状态自感知训练，后训练与可解释交叉的扎实工作

arxiv.title: Longitudinal Learner Participation Profiling in Online Learning: Heterogeneous Consensus Clustering under Unequal Observation Windows
arxiv.abstract: Learning management system traces are clustered to identify participation profiles, but unequal observation windows may cause profiles to reflect duration rather than participation alone. Using 16,448 complete learner--course sequences from 4,599 learners across 152 courses at a South African public university, we evaluated eight participation measures. All remained related to observation-window length even when expressed as rates or shares. Course-grouped adjustment reduced these relationships. Five retained measures were evaluated using K-means, Gaussian mixtures, Ward agglomerative clustering and K-medoids, with standardised measures and principal-component summaries. Evidence supported a broad two-profile grouping and a more detailed adjusted four-profile consensus: Gradually declining, Early-concentrated, Cyclical variable and Sustained active. Profile membership accounted for 2.87% of the variation in duration in the primary consensus, versus 38.18% using original measures. Mean assignment support was 0.739; 8.35% of assignments fell below 0.50, with greatest uncertainty in Sustained active. Two week-by-week sequence analyses agreed strongly with each other but only modestly with the four-profile consensus, indicating that the profiles combined multiple aspects of participation rather than distinct sequence patterns. Profiling should therefore assess duration effects, compare clustering methods and participation summaries, and report assignment consistency.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for presentation at SACAIR 2026 and publication in the conference proceedings
arxiv.titleZh: 在线学习中的纵向学习者参与画像:不等观测窗口下的异质共识聚类
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线学习平台日志常被聚类以刻画学习者参与画像，但各学习者-课程序列的观测窗口长度不等，会使画像实际反映学习时长而非参与行为。基于南非某公立大学152门课程、4599名学习者的16448条完整学习者-课程序列，评估八种参与度指标:即便换算为比率或占比，它们仍与窗口长度相关，按课程分组校正可削弱该关联。用K-means、高斯混合、Ward层次聚类与K-medoids对五种保留指标做共识聚类，支持校正后的四画像(渐降型、早期集中型、周期波动型、持续活跃型)，画像归属仅解释时长变异的2.87%，平均归属支持度0.739,8.35%的归属低于0.50。说明参与画像研究应检验时长效应、对比聚类方法与摘要方式，并报告归属一致性。
arxiv.reason: 教育场景的学习者聚类分析，不涉及LLM，属低分垂直应用

arxiv.title: A Time-Synchronous Prequential Evaluation Framework for Next-Week Student Disengagement Prediction from Moodle LMS Logs
arxiv.abstract: Retrospective evaluation of early-warning models may not reflect information available when predictions are issued and outcomes become observable. We developed a time-synchronous prequential framework for online prediction of next-week student disengagement, operationalised as inactivity onset, from Moodle logs. Ordered by calendar time, models were updated only with available outcomes and remained unchanged for all predictions at each prediction cutoff; development, calibration and evaluation were chronologically separate. We compared stochastic gradient descent logistic regression (SGD-LR), online sequential extreme learning machine (OSELM) and echo state network (ESN) across predictive performance, fixed, frozen and rolling threshold policies, calendar-time variation and four behavioural feature sets. Held-out evaluation comprised 49,329 predictions with 37.68% inactivity-onset prevalence. Discrimination was similar (average precision 0.665-0.679; ROC-AUC 0.755-0.774). OSELM had the highest recall, SGD-LR the highest precision and specificity, and ESN the highest Matthews correlation coefficient and balanced accuracy. Lower thresholds increased recall and alert volume, whereas rolling adaptation did not improve MCC over frozen thresholds. Weekly performance and calibrated-probability distributions varied without sustained deterioration. During model selection, cumulative-and-temporal features achieved the highest individual-set AP, with modest gains from combining all feature groups. These findings indicate that streaming early-warning evaluation should consider calibration, threshold-dependent performance, alert burden and calendar-time variation alongside aggregate discrimination.

arxiv.titleZh: 一种从 Moodle LMS 日志预测下周学生脱离行为的时间同步序贯评估框架

arxiv.title: Structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics for partial differential equations
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.
arxiv.titleZh: 偏微分方程保结构保真度诊断
arxiv.summaryZh: 用数值求解器数据训练的 PDE 神经代理，学到的是离散格式的修正方程而非真实物理，而基于同源求解器数据的测试损失无法区分两者。为此提出一组保结构保真度诊断指标:无需训练数据与原始方程，仅检验模型是否满足某项已知物理性质，如守恒量、对称性或哈密顿结构。在五个系统上，诊断指标与真实动力学误差的秩相关最高达 0.94，而测试损失与之不相关甚至负相关;在 Burgers、KdV 与 Navier-Stokes 方程上，还能区分测试损失视为等价的数值格式，包括同阶格式。

arxiv.title: REA: From Correct LLM Judgments to Safe Decision Delivery
arxiv.abstract: Generative safety guards must classify requests correctly and return outputs that applications can parse. Reasoning guards can improve classification accuracy while producing outputs that applications cannot parse. When applications cannot extract a correct prediction, fallback handling can allow harmful requests or block safe ones. We introduce Resolve--Express--Act (REA), a framework that traces judgments through parsing and fallback to application actions. Experiments on classifiers and safety guards show that correct predictions can appear in incorrectly formatted outputs. Parsing the safety verdict preserves the reasoning guard's accuracy advantage, while stricter explanation requirements reject additional correct predictions. Accepting formatting variations recovers most rejected correct predictions. Held-out tests confirm that output requirements and generation limits affect whether correct predictions can be parsed. In our fail-open replay, matching the parser to the output and fixing formatting reduced the fraction of harmful requests allowed despite correct guard judgments from 95.5% to 0%. A fixed-output comparison shows that model-based extraction can preserve guard verdicts, but is not automatically reliable; deterministic normalization already repairs the observed native-format failures. Fallback replay shows that the same correct prediction can lead to different safety actions depending on the parser and fallback policy, including allowing requests the guard correctly identifies as harmful.
arxiv.titleZh: REA：从正确的 LLM 判断到安全决策交付
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理型安全护栏能提升分类准确率，但其带解释的输出常无法被应用解析，正确判断因此被丢弃，回退处理又可能放行有害请求或误拦安全请求。REA（Resolve–Express–Act）框架把判断从解析、回退一路追踪到应用动作，发现正确预测常出现在格式错误的输出中。解析安全判定可保留推理护栏的准确率优势，放宽格式变化能找回大部分被拒的正确预测；在 fail-open 复现中，匹配解析器并修正格式后，判断正确却仍被放行的有害请求占比从 95.5% 降到 0%。这表明护栏的端到端效果取决于输出、解析与回退策略的匹配，适用于 LLM-as-judge 与安全护栏的部署。

arxiv.title: Scaling Inference-Time Compute with Teams of Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent systems promise a new axis for scaling inference: rather than having one agent think longer or sample more attempts, a task is split across many agents that work in parallel and coordinate. However, in practice, more agents can easily produce duplicate work, coordination failures, and higher costs. We therefore formulate team design as a compute allocation problem: starting from a solo agent, where should additional inference compute go to reach the reward-cost Pareto frontier? We build a minimal multi-agent harness from the ground up and trace this frontier by varying, one at a time, the workflow stage at which a lead delegates to its workers (planning, implementation, or verification), the models that form the team, and the number of workers. On ProgramBench, teams outperform solo agents but cost three to seven times as much. With the right compute allocation, however, a heterogeneous 17-agent team comes within 1.4 points of a strong homogeneous 5-agent team at 70% lower cost. This efficiency stems from three findings. First, planning is the most valuable use of workers: in a homogeneous team whose lead decides how many workers to spawn, a lead that delegates only planning to its workers, and then implements and verifies the code itself, matches the reward of a lead that delegates to workers throughout planning, implementation, and verification, at half the cost. Second, cheap models pay off as planners but not as implementers: a strong lead with cheap planners recovers 47.5% of the reward gain of an all-strong team for only 13.9% of its additional cost, whereas cheap implementers lower reward. Third, planners keep improving reward as the team grows, whereas implementers and verifiers plateau beyond four workers. Together, our results offer a guide to spending an agent budget where it counts, given the task, cost, and latency constraints a user has.
arxiv.titleZh: 用编码智能体团队扩展推理时计算
arxiv.summaryZh: 把多智能体团队设计形式化为推理算力分配问题：在 ProgramBench 上从单智能体出发，逐一改变 lead 委派的工作流阶段（规划、实现、验证）、团队模型构成与 worker 数量，刻画奖励—成本帕累托前沿。团队普遍优于单智能体，但成本高 3–7 倍；合理分配算力时，异构 17 智能体团队以低 70% 的成本逼近同构 5 智能体团队（差距 1.4 分）。关键发现：委派规划收益最高，lead 只把规划交给 worker、自己实现与验证可在半成本下取得同等奖励；弱模型适合当规划者而非实现者（以 13.9% 的额外成本回收 47.5% 的奖励增益）；规划者随团队扩张持续增益，实现者与验证者超过 4 个后收益饱和。

arxiv.title: Assessing the Performance of AI Models in Misinformation Detection Using Predefined Social Noise Constructs
arxiv.abstract: Social media platforms generate vast volumes of user-generated content that often obscure meaningful discourse, a phenomenon conceptualized as social noise. While existing misinformation detection methods primarily focus on factual verification, they largely overlook the role of social noise in amplifying misinformation. This study assesses the performance of six text-based models and a graph neural network (GNN) in mitigating the effects of misinformation using predefined social noise constructs. The dataset consists of 500,000 tweets collected from the X platform using the Ukraine hashtag during the Russia-Ukraine conflict from March 2024 to March 2025. Advanced machine learning models achieve strong performance, with accuracies ranging from 79.94% to 97.17%. RoBERTa demonstrates the highest performance, with an accuracy of 97.17%, Cohen's kappa of 0.9660, MCC of 0.9660, and AUC of 0.9977. The GNN achieves an accuracy of 64.52% and an AUC of 0.899, demonstrating performance above random-chance classification by exploiting the relational structure between tweets. All text-based models achieve kappa values greater than 0.75, indicating substantial overall agreement. Explainable AI analysis using LIME reveals that 89.6% of predictive weight is attributed to contextual features rather than isolated keywords. The findings highlight that integrating social noise into AI pipelines enhances misinformation detection and supports more effective mitigation strategies in large-scale social media environments.

arxiv.title: An FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Network for Spatiotemporal Pattern Learning and Classification
arxiv.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient spatiotemporal pattern recognition at the edge, but efficient deployment and on-device adaptation require specialized hardware. In this work, we present an FPGA implementation of multilayer SNNs for spatiotemporal pattern classification, in which both inference and training take place on the same hardware. Our design adopts a temporal-forward-only training algorithm that avoids the memory and latency overhead associated with traditional Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT). A mixed-precision scheme balances training stability with resource efficiency, and architectural optimization maximizes hardware and memory utilization. We further identify and resolve hazards that arise when inference and learning share the same memory, including port conflicts between the forward and backward access patterns and read-after-write dependencies in floating-point potential accumulation. Experimental evaluations on MNIST and five multivariate time-series classification datasets demonstrate that, with fully on-chip training, our SNN model achieves accuracy comparable to SNN or LSTM trained with BPTT. Compared to CPU and GPU based implementations, our FPGA design delivers 2.5 to 6 times higher throughput while consuming an order of magnitude less energy per sample.
arxiv.titleZh: 一种用于时空模式学习与分类的 FPGA 脉冲神经网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对脉冲神经网络在边缘端时空模式识别中部署与在线适配依赖专用硬件的问题，该工作在一块 FPGA 上实现多层 SNN 的推理与训练一体化，采用仅时间前向的训练算法替代 BPTT 以规避其显存与延迟开销，并用混合精度方案平衡训练稳定性与资源占用。作者还定位并解决了推理与学习共享同一内存时的端口冲突与前向-后向访问模式竞争、浮点膜电位累加的写后读依赖等冒险。在 MNIST 与五个多元时间序列分类数据集上，全片上训练的精度与用 BPTT 训练的 SNN 或 LSTM 相当，吞吐量比 CPU/GPU 实现高 2.5 至 6 倍，单样本能耗低一个数量级。

arxiv.title: Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions
arxiv.abstract: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过匹配内部文本预测，将文本 LM 蒸馏为语音到语音 LM
arxiv.summaryZh: 已有的文本 LM 知识蒸馏工作多集中在语音输入、文本输出的模型，语音到语音模型如何继承文本 LM 的语言与事实能力尚未被探索。该工作提出一种语音到语音预训练方法:模型先接收不带转写的语音上下文，切换到文本预测，再用预测出的文本逐词引导后续语音生成，从而在保持纯语音输入输出的同时造出内部文本接口，可直接从基座文本 LM 蒸馏。在同等训练条件下，该序列构造显著改善语音续写的生成困惑度，逼近带外部 ASR 转写提示的文本主导内部独白模型，并在文本与语音两种评测下均提升事实性表现，说明基座文本 LM 的知识保留更好。

arxiv.title: Compositional RL: Evaluating and Training LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Language models are often evaluated alone but increasingly deployed together, routed between, made to debate, ensembled, or collaboratively trained. For a model inside a system, what matters most is not how well it performs on its own, but how much the system gains from its presence. We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.
arxiv.titleZh: 组合式强化学习:评估与训练 LLM 的协作推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型常被单独评测，却越来越多地被路由、辩论、集成或联合训练后共同部署，其在系统中的价值取决于给系统带来的增益而非单体性能。作者把这种「组合强度」形式化为模型池联盟博弈的 Shapley 值，以留一贡献为可计算代理，把评测成本从 2^n 降到 n+1;在 5 个模型池、12 种协作方法、12 个数据集上发现二者基本不相关，15 个设置中有 12 个如此。为此提出组合强化学习 C-RL:在真实多模型系统内训练策略、奖励系统整体输出，Shapley 的留一基线在组策略梯度下相互抵消，不增加 rollout 成本。在 3 种协议、8 个任务的 24 个设置中，21 个取得最强协作者，平均提升 +4.0 至 +5.4 分，最高 +13.1 分。
