arxiv.title: Effect of Spherical Parameter Space on Number of Non-Forgetting Tasks and Capacity of Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: We propose a continuous learning formulation for $T$ non-forgetting tasks with the spherical parameter space $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ in asymptotic regime $d\rightarrow \infty$. Each task $i$ has an optimum $\bmΘ_i$, minimizing its corresponding loss function $R_i(\bm{w})$ on sphere. We reduce each task $i$ to an acceptable loss region modeled by a geodesic ball $B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$ on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ centered at $\bmΘ_i$ with radius $r_i(d)$. To model task dependencies (similarities), task optima $\bmΘ_i$ are distributed by a Neyman-Scott clustered point process $Φ$. Cluster centers $\{\bm{Y}_j\}_{j=1}^{N_p}$ form a homogeneous Poisson point process on sphere, while intra-cluster task optima follow a von Mises-Fisher distribution with mean $\bm{Y}_j$ and concentration $κ$. Each task $t\in \{1, ..., T\}$ learning algorithm is considered to be a channel $Q_{t}(\mathrm{d}\bm{w}_t | \bm{w}_{t-1}, \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmθ_{1:t-1}), \bmθ_t)$, where $\bm{W}_t$ is the learned parameter of task $t$ and $\mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})=\bigcap_{i=1}^{t-1}B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$. Since in continual learning, the learner does not need to reach $\bmΘ_t$ exactly to successfully learn task $t$, to avoid forgetting as well as reliable learning, it only needs for the learned parameter vector $\bm{W}_{t}$ to enter $B_{\bmΘ_t}(r_t(d)) \cap \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})$. Using this model, we derive an upper bound on $T$ ensuring $\mathbb{P}[\mathcal{K}_{T}(\bmΘ_{1:T}) \neq \emptyset] \rightarrow 1$ as $d\rightarrow \infty$ and $κ/d \rightarrow α$, where $α>0$ is a constant. Finally, for $T$ tasks sampled uniformly from $Φ$, we derive an upper bound for total information theoretic capacity under the non-forgetting constraint for each task.
arxiv.titleZh: 球面参数空间对非遗忘任务数量与持续学习容量的影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究持续学习在球面参数空间中的非遗忘任务数量上限与信息容量。将每个任务的最优解建模为球面上的测地线球，任务依赖用 Neyman-Scott 聚类点过程刻画，学习算法视为信道，只要学到的参数进入当前任务球与历史可接受区域的交集即可避免遗忘。在 d→∞ 且 κ/d→α 的渐近条件下，推导出保证 T 个任务交集非空的概率趋于 1 的任务数上界，并给出均匀采样任务下的总信息论容量上界。为持续学习的容量与任务相似性关系提供理论刻画，偏理论分析。

arxiv.title: On Sleep-Wake Disorder Identification from Polysomnographic Representations
arxiv.abstract: Self-supervised polysomnography foundation models (PSG FMs) aim to capture clinically useful information beyond sleep staging, yet are rarely compared with sleep-staging encoders pretrained at comparable scale and modality coverage. Using a common whole-night, missingness-aware state-space downstream modeling framework, we compared frozen representations from prominent large-scale, multi-cohort sleep-stage-supervised encoders and self-supervised PSG FMs for multilabel identification of six sleep-wake and circadian disorder groups in 7,906 PSGs from an unseen registry. Although PSG FMs outperformed an EEG-only, single-cohort supervised baseline, this ordering reversed when supervised pretraining approached comparable scale and modality coverage. Transfer learning from neural sleep scorers achieved higher overall performance while exhibiting greater downstream data efficiency. These findings underscore the need for scale- and modality-matched pretrained supervised baselines when assessing PSG FMs' downstream potential.
arxiv.titleZh: 论基于多导睡眠图表征的睡眠—觉醒障碍识别
arxiv.summaryZh: 用统一的整夜、缺失感知状态空间下游建模框架，在来自未见注册队列的 7906 份多导睡眠图上，比较冻结表征对六类睡眠—觉醒与昼夜节律障碍的多标签识别效果，对比对象为大规模多队列睡眠分期监督编码器与自监督 PSG 基础模型。结果显示，自监督 PSG 基础模型虽优于仅用 EEG、单队列的监督基线，但一旦监督预训练的规模与模态覆盖相当，排名即反转;从神经睡眠分期器迁移学习取得更高整体性能，且下游数据效率更好。结论是评估 PSG 基础模型的下游潜力时必须使用规模与模态匹配的监督基线。

arxiv.title: The belief-action gap in language model agents
arxiv.abstract: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型智能体中的信念—行动鸿沟
arxiv.summaryZh: LM 智能体失败的原因各异，需区分是「信息缺失」还是「信息未转化为行动」。研究在文本渲染的网格世界中，用基于自报告的探针与基于内部表征的探针估计任务相关信念，并用逆强化学习估计动作价值，同时追踪推理全程的动作偏好。结果显示:任务相关的状态与价值信息在表征上往往比行为中体现得更可靠;决策在某个「承诺点」附近迅速收敛，报告的不确定性也随之下降，但单个信念的变化并不能稳定解释动作偏好的转变;把其他决策的推理前缀移植过来时，强制动作会跟随该前缀，而编辑推理窗口激活对动作的控制有限。该测量框架把「信息可得性」与「信念—行动一致性」分开，适用于诊断 Agent 推理与执行脱节的问题。
arxiv.reason: Agent 信念—行动一致性诊断，命中 Agent 与评测方向，环境规模有限

arxiv.title: Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions
arxiv.abstract: The success of autonomous research systems relies on the quality of the scientific hypotheses they generate. Recent studies report that human reviewers often rate LLM-generated ideas as more novel than those from human experts, raising hope that AI can accelerate scientific discovery. Yet it is unclear whether these models can do more than extend existing knowledge. Can LLMs drive genuine innovation by revealing new research directions, or are they limited to repeating and recombining what science already knows? This unresolved question lies at the heart of discussions about AI and the future of science. To address this, we distinguish two types of novelty: distance, which measures how far a hypothesis lies from existing work, and direction, which captures whether the hypothesis pursues new lines of inquiry beyond those already present. These two measures diverge sharply for LLM-generated work. We represent scientific papers in a shared conceptual space using a pretrained scientific-paper embedding model. Within this space, we embed 26.9 million human-authored papers across 1,325 research topics in six natural-science fields and 524,308 LLM-generated hypotheses from eight models. Distance is measured using existing metrics. To quantify direction, we introduce the orthogonal novelty score (ONS). LLMs consistently generate ideas more distant from existing work than human-authored papers, up to 16\% further when the LLM is given the papers farthest from the centre of the topic. However, LLM hypotheses have a 15--23\% lower median ONS than published papers from the same topic. Thus, LLMs move further from what is already known, but remain within established directions. This pattern persists across changes in various configurations. As a result, LLMs excel at extending the frontier but the creation of new directions is still led by human scientists.
arxiv.titleZh: 大语言模型拓展已知研究，但不创造新的研究方向
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 能否提出真正原创的科学假设这一问题，区分“距离”与“方向”两类新颖性：用预训练科学论文嵌入模型，把六大自然科学领域 1325 个主题下的 2690 万篇人类论文与 8 个模型生成的 52.4 万条假设映射到同一概念空间；距离沿用已有指标，方向由新提出的正交新颖性分数（ONS）度量。结果显示 LLM 假设离已有工作更远（最多远 16%），但 ONS 中位数比同主题已发表论文低 15–23%，即走得更远却仍停留在既有方向内。LLM 擅长拓展前沿，开辟新方向仍由人类科学家主导。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 实证：新指标 ONS 度量方向新颖性，命中科研智能体方向

arxiv.title: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. SchemaWeaver can be generically applied to the LLM inference engine on mobile devices without involving any training efforts or changes on LLMs, and our experiment results on major mobile SoCs and LLM families show that SchemaWeaver can reduce the LLM tool calling latency by up to 3.9 times, compared to the competitive baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: SchemaWeaver:通过 Schema 引导的并行 LLM 解码加速端侧移动 Agentic AI
arxiv.summaryZh: 端侧 LLM 作为 Agent 调用外部工具时延迟高，瓶颈在受内存带宽而非算力限制的解码阶段。SchemaWeaver 利用工具调用 Schema 的约束信息，在解码阶段一次生成多个 token 实现 Schema 引导的并行解码，无需任何训练或改动模型即可接入移动端推理引擎。在主流移动 SoC 与多个 LLM 家族上，工具调用延迟相比强基线最高降低 3.9 倍，为端侧 Agent 的实时响应提供了即插即用的加速方案。
arxiv.reason: 端侧 Agent 工具调用解码加速，命中效率与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Monarch-Muon: Structure-Aware Muon for Fast and Memory-Efficient Pretraining
arxiv.abstract: Training large language models is constrained by both wall-clock time and memory footprint, and recent matrix-aware optimizers sharpen this tradeoff: Muon can improve optimization but its dense polar update remains expensive. We propose Monarch-Muon, a structured matrix-aware optimizer for weights parameterized by Monarch factors. The resulting structure reduces weights, gradients, and optimizer state, and exposes small independent update subproblems in place of a single dense orthogonalization; we formalize this through a blockwise trust-region interpretation. In quality runs, Monarch-Muon improves over Monarch-AdamW at fixed structure: 3.06 vs. 3.09 in the dense 257M model and 2.68 vs. 2.77 in the 1B MoE model; the two-block MoE variant also matches dense AdamW while using 15% fewer active and 25.4% fewer total parameters. In 6.89B-parameter systems measurements, Monarch-Muon reduces peak memory from 68.9 to 52.9 GB, Muon optimizer state from 14.60 to 6.77 GB, and the Muon optimizer step from 1288 to 304 ms.
arxiv.titleZh: Monarch-Muon：面向快速且内存高效预训练的结构感知 Muon
arxiv.summaryZh: Muon 优化器的稠密极分解更新开销大，成为大模型预训练在显存与单步耗时上的瓶颈。Monarch-Muon 面向 Monarch 因子化参数，把单一稠密正交化拆成若干独立的小规模子问题，使权重、梯度与优化器状态随之结构化压缩，并以分块信赖域视角给出理论解释。质量实验中，稠密 257M 模型验证损失 3.06 优于 Monarch-AdamW 的 3.09,1B MoE 上为 2.68 对 2.77，双块 MoE 变体在少用 15% 激活参数、25.4% 总参数的情况下追平稠密 AdamW。6.89B 规模系统测量显示峰值显存从 68.9 GB 降至 52.9 GB,Muon 优化器状态从 14.60 GB 降至 6.77 GB，单步耗时从 1288 ms 降至 304 ms。
arxiv.reason: Muon 优化器结构化改造，预训练显存与速度双收益

arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning In Partially Verifiable Environments for Colon Cancer Treatment Planning
arxiv.abstract: Clinical decision-making is a sequential process of information collection, clinical inference, and forecasting under partial observability, often without a uniquely correct treatment decision. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong medical question-answering capabilities but extending these advances to clinical reasoning remains challenging because many clinical tasks are only partially verifiable. Recent clinical reinforcement learning (RL) work has therefore largely focused on diagnostic endpoints, where correctness can be more directly verified. Oncology treatment decision making is a particularly challenging instance of this problem that extends beyond medical question-answering in which multiple decision trajectories can be clinically defensible for the same partially observed patient state. We formulate oncology treatment planning as an interactive RL problem under partial observability and construct patient-specific, process-aware rewards from decision processes observed in real world clinical records. The agent must learn to sequentially acquire information from a structured patient representation before committing to a first-line treatment recommendation, and is evaluated on information gathering, treatment selection, and reasoning alignment. Using GRPO and GDPO to optimize Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct within this environment, RL substantially improves the base policy beyond frontier model capabilities. The GDPO-trained policy increases Mean@3 scalar clinical reward by $79.60\%$ over base Llama and exceeds GPT-5.2 by $18.82\%$ under the same interactive environment, while reducing query count during training. Overall, our results show that patient-specific, partially verifiable rewards can provide an effective learning signal for interactive clinical RL when both the patient state and the underlying clinical decision process are only partially observed.
arxiv.titleZh: 部分可验证环境下的强化学习用于结肠癌治疗规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床决策是部分可观测下的序贯信息收集与推理过程，同一患者状态常存在多个临床可接受的方案，奖励因此只能部分验证。该工作把肿瘤治疗方案规划建模为交互式 RL 问题，从真实病历的决策过程中构造患者特异、过程感知的奖励;智能体需先从结构化患者表征中逐步采集信息，再给出首选治疗推荐，并从信息收集、治疗选择与推理一致性三方面评测。用 GRPO 与 GDPO 优化 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,GDPO 策略的 Mean@3 临床标量奖励较基座提升 79.60%，在相同交互环境下超过 GPT-5.2 达 18.82%，同时训练中查询次数减少。
arxiv.reason: 医疗垂直应用，GRPO 部分可验证奖励仅作工具，偏离主线

arxiv.title: When Sparsity Breaks Connectivity: Functional Reachability and Guided Topology Dynamics in Extreme Sparse Training
arxiv.abstract: Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. At extreme sparsity ($\ge 99\%$), this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways, and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. We formalize forward, backward, and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs, derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges, and show that Monte Carlo realizations match the theory. Guided by this reachability-based structure, we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. We introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as Reachability-guided in DST, referred to as guided DST. On CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet, guided DST recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided DST (up to $+14.4$ points at $99.9\%$ sparsity on CIFAR-100), and on MLP-Mixer guided DST remains trainable at $99.99\%$ sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. These results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/mzjaworski/ea_dst.
arxiv.titleZh: 当稀疏性破坏连通性:极端稀疏训练中的功能可达性与引导式拓扑动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 极端稀疏(≥99%)下动态稀疏训练(DST)的剪枝-再生会切断输入到输出的信息通路，标准幅度/随机更新随之失效。该工作在前馈稀疏图上形式化前向、反向与功能可达性，给出可达神经元与边数的闭式期望，并用蒙特卡洛实现验证理论。基于此把剪枝偏向非功能边、再生偏向功能一致的候选，形成可达性引导的 DST。在 CIFAR-10/100 与 Tiny ImageNet 上最高挽回 14.4 个点(CIFAR-100,99.9% 稀疏),MLP-Mixer 在 99.99% 稀疏下仍可训练。该视角把极端稀疏训练刻画为保持连通性的动力学过程，适用于高效训练与稀疏化部署。
arxiv.reason: 稀疏训练与高效训练擦边，但非 LLM 方向，属扎实但分量有限的增量工作

arxiv.title: On Making $\mathrm{SE}(2)$-Invariant Networks Optimal
arxiv.abstract: Respecting a-priori known symmetries of underlying data is a key principle in designing efficient neural architectures. Convolutional neural networks are a canonical example, encoding translation equivariance. Extending this inductive bias to richer symmetry groups such as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ in the most effective way possible is an ongoing architectural and computational challenge. Building on classical invariant theory, we derive invariant feature maps that are provably optimal: minimal and information-preserving with respect to the symmetry group. Our construction is designed to integrate seamlessly into standard architectures, requiring no modification to nonlinearities or normalization layers. As a concrete implementation, we introduce a plug-and-play module for convolutional neural networks that enforces $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ invariance, capturing both translations and rotations within standard architectures. The resulting models are both efficient and expressive. Experiments show competitive or improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art equivariant methods at significantly lower computational cost. Finally, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of the relationship between equivariance and invariance, offering insight into their roles in controlling robustness and flexibility.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the main track of NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 论如何使 SE(2) 不变网络达到最优
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对在卷积网络中高效嵌入 SE(2)(平移加旋转)对称性的难题，基于经典不变量理论推导出可证明最优的不变特征映射——在对称群意义下最小且信息无损，且无需修改非线性层与归一化层即可嵌入标准架构。据此实现一个即插即用模块，使常规 CNN 同时获得平移与旋转不变性。实验在显著更低的计算成本下取得与当前最优等变方法相当或更好的精度，并给出等变性与不变性关系的理论与实证分析，说明二者如何影响鲁棒性与灵活性。
arxiv.reason: 几何等变网络理论，与 LLM / Agent 方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Why Agentic Workflows Fail: A Taxonomy Derived from Literature and Empirical Data
arxiv.abstract: Agentic workflows combine large language models with planning, memory, tools, execution environments, and iterative feedback. Their failures are difficult to diagnose because the same user-visible symptom may originate from model behavior, workflow orchestration, external tools, infrastructure, or their interaction. This paper presents a source-aware taxonomy of agentic workflow failures and applies it to evidence from academic literature and GitHub. The taxonomy combines source attribution with three empirical dimensions: a concrete failure-type dictionary, workflow-stage localization, and agent-capability localization. Its central structure is a two-axis localization matrix: workflow stages form the horizontal process axis and agent capabilities form the vertical functional axis. This design moves beyond taxonomies that mainly classify final failure manifestations by localizing intermediate process states inside agent operation. Our empirical comparison shows that literature-derived failures emphasize planning, reasoning, learning, perception, and knowledge-related mechanisms, whereas GitHub-derived failures concentrate on execution-stage, actuation-related, tool, API, and infrastructure failures. The dominant hotspot is iterative execution and actuation. These findings indicate that agentic workflow reliability should be treated as a systems problem rather than only a model-output problem. The taxonomy provides a basis for structured evaluation, root cause analysis, failure injection, and engineering triage.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic Workflow 为何失败:一个源自文献与实证数据的分类体系
arxiv.summaryZh: Agentic workflow 把大模型与规划、记忆、工具、执行环境和迭代反馈组合起来，同一用户可见症状可能源自模型、编排、外部工具或基础设施，根因难以定位。该工作提出「来源感知」的失败分类体系，由失败类型词典、workflow 阶段定位与 agent 能力定位三个经验维度构成，核心是「workflow 阶段(横轴)×agent 能力(纵轴)」的双轴定位矩阵，从而在 agent 运行的中间过程状态上定位失败，而非只对最终表现分类。基于文献与 GitHub 数据的对比显示，文献中的失败集中在规划、推理、学习、感知与知识相关机制，而 GitHub 上的失败集中在执行阶段、驱动、工具、API 与基础设施，最热区域是迭代执行与驱动。结论是 agentic workflow 的可靠性应按系统问题而非单纯的模型输出问题来对待，该体系可用于结构化评估、根因分析、故障注入与工程分诊。
arxiv.reason: Agent 失败分类与可靠性系统视角，命中 Agent 方向但属体系归纳类工作

arxiv.title: Agency as a New Organizing Abstraction for Computer Science
arxiv.abstract: Advances in large-scale machine learning have enabled agentic AI systems: persistent, autonomous computational entities that pursue goals, initiate actions, and interact with open environments. These systems are often framed as applications of foundation models. We argue that this framing is incomplete: agency is also a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science. What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. Where the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources: a process executes a program; an agent pursues a goal. From this perspective, the recurring failures of deployed agentic systems (runaway resource consumption, behavior redirected by adversarial content, opaque continuous operation) are symptoms of structural abstraction gaps, not isolated engineering defects. We examine these gaps across six dimensions (execution, interfaces, correctness, oversight, coordination, and persistence) and argue that closing them requires coordinated advances in systems,
arxiv.comment: An extended version of a paper to appear in Communications of the ACM, November 2026
arxiv.titleZh: Agency 作为计算机科学的新组织抽象
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对已部署智能体系统频发的资源失控、被对抗内容劫持、长期运行不透明等故障，论文主张把 Agency(能动性)看作与「进程」并列的计算机科学组织抽象:进程执行程序，智能体则在有限资源下追逐目标，能从目标、观测与记忆中合成开放式的行动方案。作者沿执行、接口、正确性、监督、协调与持久化六个维度剖析现有抽象缺口，认为这些故障是结构性抽象缺失的症状，而非孤立的工程缺陷，并呼吁系统与 AI 两个方向协同推进。该视角对智能体运行时、资源治理与安全监督等工程实践有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: Agent 抽象与系统设计框架，直击智能体工程痛点

arxiv.title: Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL
arxiv.abstract: We argue that cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should treat test-time coordination as part of the problem definition rather than a deployment artifact. Our focus is on long-horizon, centrally monitored cooperative systems such as warehouse robotics, automated storage-and-retrieval systems, and cloud-resource scheduling, where teams share a reward, operate under shifting objectives, and already run with global telemetry at deployment. The dominant paradigm in this regime, centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE), uses global information only during training and provides no coordination channel at execution. This is sufficient when agents are weakly coupled or the environment is stationary, but it fails when the team must realign after conditions change. The limitation is structural rather than algorithmic, and more training cannot add a channel that does not exist at execution time. We call this the recoverability gap. To address it, we name the underexplored design space of intermittent test-time coordination as centralized training with mixed execution (CTME), in which a coordinator observes global state and emits high-level signals while agents act locally. CTME is not a particular learning algorithm, but a cooperative MARL problem setting that makes test-time information structure explicit. It specifies team-level information, high-level signals, and update frequency after training, with CTDE recovered as a limit case. We do not argue that CTDE is obsolete. We argue that removing the test-time channel is a modeling choice, not a necessity, and the wrong default when global telemetry is available and teams must recover from drift.
arxiv.titleZh: 立场:超越训练阶段，测试时协调对协作式 MARL 不可或缺
arxiv.summaryZh: 主张把测试时协调纳入合作式多智能体强化学习的问题定义，而非仅当作部署细节。主流 CTDE 范式只在训练期使用全局信息，执行时不存在协调通道，当目标或环境漂移后团队无法重新对齐，作者称之为可恢复性缺口，并强调这是结构性问题而非算法问题，再多的训练也补不出执行期不存在的通道。为此定义 CTME(集中训练、混合执行)设定:协调者在部署时观察全局状态并发出高层信号，智能体仍本地行动，CTDE 成为其极限特例，并规定团队级信息、高层信号与更新频率三个要素。适用对象是仓储机器人、自动存取系统与云资源调度等已有全局遥测的长时程协作场景。
arxiv.reason: 经典 MARL 立场文，与 LLM 后训练 / Agent 方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation
arxiv.abstract: Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. These findings motivate a staged optimization strategy in CrossTF: after training and freezing both denoisers, it only needs to learn step-specific fusion parameters within this window using an Extreme Value Theory-based objective under an energy-distance constraint. This formulation supports interpolation between and extrapolation beyond the view-specific estimates while limiting degradation in overall generation quality. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets against 11 baselines show that CrossTF improves extreme fidelity by 26.1% and overall performance by 7.4% relative to the strongest baselines. These results highlight cross-view discrepancy as an effective basis for low-dimensional optimization in extreme-aware time-series generation.
arxiv.titleZh: 跨视图时频扩散用于极端事件感知的时间序列生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成真实时间序列需要忠实复现稀有但高影响的极端事件。CrossTF 利用时间视图与频率视图去噪器之间的估计差异，发现沿两视图干净样本估计连线的方向移动能显著改变极端保真度而几乎不影响整体生成质量，并定位到该差异趋于稳定的后期跨视图窗口。据此在冻结两个去噪器后，仅需在该窗口内以极值理论目标、在能量距离约束下学习逐步融合参数，支持视图估计间的插值与外推。在七个真实数据集上与 11 个基线对比，极端保真度提升 26.1%，整体性能提升 7.4%。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型用于时间序列生成，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
arxiv.abstract: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.
arxiv.comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Corpus, model outputs and analysis code available at https://github.com/sakhadib/llm-temporal-interval-reasoning
arxiv.titleZh: 评估大语言模型的时间推理:基于 Allen 区间代数、逻辑一致性与叙事相对时间的事件时间关系抽取
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对叙事级时间推理，让五个 LLM 为 360 篇英文叙事重建覆盖Allen 13种区间关系的完整事件网络，并按预注册协议考察其与金标的一致性、逆否一致性与逻辑可满足性。最佳模型在macro-F1上明显超过平凡基线，却仍不及「一律回答before」的准确率，差距主要来自解析伪影:大矩阵格式错误导致整行丢失，后验解析器将覆盖率从0.60提升至0.84后即追平基线。模型在已作答单元格上能恢复先后与包含关系，几乎不识别重叠，闪回叙事错误最多;逻辑一致性与金标一致率关联很弱，强制一致性主要靠填空生效。
arxiv.reason: LLM时间推理评测，属评测方法学方向，但任务较窄、非后训练/Agent核心议题

arxiv.title: Generalizable field of view extension for diffusion MRI via conditional flow matching
arxiv.abstract: Incomplete field-of-view (FOV) diffusion MRI (dMRI) acquisitions compromise whole-brain white matter analysis by excluding brain regions from tractography and connectivity studies. While deep generative models for dMRI FOV extension have been proposed, their generalizability remains limited by the acquisition-dependent nature of dMRI, where signal intensity varies with b-value, gradient direction, and scanner protocol, and the inherent 4D complexity of the data, making it difficult to train models that transfer across sites or acquisition schemes without retraining. We propose a flow-matching generative model that extends the dMRI FOV in both the superior and inferior directions by predicting apparent diffusion coefficients (ADC) in six directions, conditioned on the two nearest acquired slices and the full-FOV T1w image to enforce both local diffusion continuity and anatomical consistency. The ADC representation decouples the model from acquisition-specific b-values and gradient directions, providing a middle-ground across protocols. The model was trained on 3,103 subjects (5,105 sessions) across five different datasets spanning diverse acquisition schemes (b = 500 and 1000 s/mm$^2$; 21--192 gradient directions), four single-shell (b = 1000) and one multi-shell (b = 500/1000). Evaluated on 299 subjects across five independent datasets spanning b = 750--1500 s/mm$^2$ and 32--90 gradient directions, with single- and multi-shell schemes unseen during training, the proposed method achieves significantly improved bundle Dice score on downstream tractography (p < 0.01).
arxiv.titleZh: 基于条件流匹配的可泛化扩散 MRI 视野扩展
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对扩散 MRI 视野不全导致全脑白质纤维追踪与连接分析缺失的问题，提出条件流匹配生成模型，通过预测六个方向的 ADC 补全上下方向视野，以最近两层已采集切片与全视野 T1w 图像为条件，兼顾局部扩散连续性与解剖一致性;ADC 表示使模型与具体 b 值、梯度方向解耦。在五个数据集 3103 名被试(5105 次扫描，b=500/1000,21–192 个梯度方向)上训练，并在五个独立数据集 299 名被试、b=750–1500、32–90 个梯度方向的未见协议上评测，下游纤维追踪的束 Dice 显著提升(p<0.01)。
arxiv.reason: 医学影像 dMRI 视野补全，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting
arxiv.abstract: Continuous monitoring of generative AI systems requires detecting distribution shifts in the unstructured data they ingest and generate. Existing monitoring methods typically control false alarms by requiring the discrepancy measure used to detect shifts to be *pre-specified*. However, for unstructured data, pre-specification creates a sensitivity--breadth trade-off: a narrowly defined measure is sensitive to the anticipated shift but may miss unexpected changes, whereas a broadly defined measure may detect a wider range of shifts but with reduced sensitivity. Although adaptively hypothesizing the shift direction can overcome this limitation, such data-dependent adaptation generally invalidates conventional false-alarm guarantees. We reconcile adaptivity with statistical validity through testing-by-betting, reframing sequential changepoint detection as a betting game in which the bettor continually updates its hypothesized shift direction, or witness function, as new observations arrive. We introduce *asymptotic e-detectors*, which approximate the pre-change distribution using a calibration set of size $m$, and prove that they asymptotically control the average run length to a false alarm as $m$ increases. Empirically, calibration sets as small as $m=30$ provide effective control. We then develop adaptive monitoring strategies ranging from black-box bettors that learn from embeddings to interpretable bettors based on LLM-proposed concepts. Across three real-world datasets, including data from a clinical AI scribe deployment, adaptive monitors detect shifts faster than fixed monitors at the same false-alarm level. Further, when the true shifts are sparse and interpretable, LLM-concept monitors provide the fastest and most interpretable detection, while also guiding root-cause diagnosis for complex shifts.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过下注式监控学习检测非结构化数据流中的分布漂移
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对生成式 AI 系统持续监控中漂移度量必须预先设定、从而在敏感性与覆盖面之间取舍的问题，把序贯变点检测重构为下注博弈:下注者随新观测不断更新所假设的漂移方向(见证函数)，提出的渐近 e-detector 用规模为 m 的校准集近似漂移前分布，并证明 m 增大时渐近控制平均误报间隔，校准集小至 m=30 即可有效。监控策略从基于嵌入的黑箱下注器延伸到由 LLM 提出概念的可解释下注器。在三个真实数据集(含临床 AI 记录部署数据)上，同等误报水平下自适应监控比固定监控更快检出漂移;当真实漂移稀疏且可解释时，LLM 概念监控检出最快，并可指导复杂漂移的根因诊断。
arxiv.reason: 漂移监控方法学，用到 LLM 概念但偏统计检测

arxiv.title: JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a post-training approach for large language models (LLMs) that enables a student model to learn a teacher model's distribution from sequences sampled from the student's own policy. Despite its promising capability, OPD for diffusion language models (DLMs) remains underexplored and existing studies primarily focuses on DLM-to-DLM distillation. The limited availability of strong teacher DLMs and the flexible generation order of DLMs impose additional technical challenges as well. However, it remains unclear how to effectively distill knowledge from a strong autoregressive language model (ARM) into a weaker DLM, given the mismatch between the left-to-right decoding of ARMs and the flexible decoding order of DLMs. Inspired by Ni et al. (2026), we propose JustOPD, an ARM-to-DLM on-policy distillation method that uses autoregressive rollouts during training to align the student's generation process with the ARM teacher's left-to-right decoding. This alignment enables effective distillation from ARM teachers while preserving the DLM's flexible generation-order capability at inference time. Experiments using Qwen3-14B as the teacher and Dream-7B as the student demonstrate that JustOPD consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices.
arxiv.titleZh: JustOPD:从自回归语言模型到扩散语言模型的在线策略蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有在线策略蒸馏(OPD)研究多局限于扩散语言模型(DLM)之间的蒸馏，而自回归模型从左到右的解码与DLM灵活的生成顺序存在错配，导致难以把强自回归教师的知识迁移到较弱的DLM学生。JustOPD在训练阶段采用自回归式rollout，使学生的生成过程与ARM教师的从左到右解码对齐，同时在推理时保留DLM的灵活生成顺序。以Qwen3-14B为教师、Dream-7B为学生，在多种散度选择下均稳定提升数学推理表现。
arxiv.reason: OPD命中后训练方向，但对象为扩散语言模型，属明确排除项

arxiv.title: Learning to Play: Reinforcement Learning and Games
arxiv.abstract: Amazing breakthroughs in reinforcement learning have taken place. Computers teach themselves to play Chess and Go and beat world champions. There is talk about expanding application areas towards general artificial intelligence (AI). The breakthroughs in Backgammon, Checkers, Chess, Atari, Go, Poker, and StarCraft have shown that we can build machines that exhibit intelligent game playing of the highest level. These successes have been widely publicized in the media, and inspire AI entrepreneurs and scientists alike. Reinforcement learning in games has become a mainstream AI research topic. It is a broad topic, and the successes build on a range of diverse techniques, from exact planning algorithms, to adaptive sampling, deep function approximation, and ingenious self-play methods. Perhaps because of the breadth of these technologies, or because of the recency of the breakthroughs, there are few books that explain these methods in depth. This book covers all methods in one comprehensive volume, explaining the latest research, bringing you as close as possible to working implementations, with many references to the original research papers. The programming examples in this book are in Python, the language in which most current reinforcement learning research is conducted. We help you to get started with machine learning frameworks such as Gym, TensorFlow, and Keras, and provide exercises to help understand how AI is learning to play.
arxiv.titleZh: 《学会博弈:强化学习与游戏》
arxiv.summaryZh: 强化学习在西洋双陆棋、跳棋、国际象棋、Atari、围棋、扑克与星际争霸上接连击败人类顶尖选手，但相关方法分散且缺少系统深入的教材。本书用 342 页把精确规划、自适应采样、深度函数逼近与自博弈等方法收拢在一卷内，贴近可运行实现，并大量引用原始论文。配套 Python 示例，引导读者上手 Gym、TensorFlow 与 Keras，并给出练习。适合作为强化学习与博弈算法的入门与案头参考。
arxiv.reason: 经典 RL 与博弈教材，与 LLM 后训练仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Day-ahead (DA) electricity price forecasting is usually posed per market, with a separate model fitted to each grid's own history. This caps accuracy: statistical and tree-based baselines saturate, while higher-capacity sequence models need more training data than a single market's few years of hourly prices can supply. Such methods also treat each node as an independent series, discarding the spatial dependencies induced by network topology and congestion. Because price formation across independent system operators (ISOs) is driven by shared physics and largely common market design, we instead treat cross-market history as a pretraining corpus. We present MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer, meta-trained across markets so that a single zone-count-independent parameter set adapts to an unseen grid. On a leak-free benchmark of five U.S. ISOs, where every model receives the same prices, DA load forecasts and calendar features, MetaGrid attains the lowest average MAE, improving on the best baseline by 3.1\% and on the same architecture trained from scratch by 7.7\%.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI Foundations for Power Grids
arxiv.titleZh: 面向电力价格预测的跨市场元学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 日前电价预测通常按市场单独建模，每个电网仅用自身历史拟合模型，导致统计与树模型精度饱和、高容量序列模型受限于单市场数年的小时级数据，同时把各节点当作独立序列而丢弃了网络拓扑与阻塞带来的空间依赖。MetaGrid 将跨市场历史视为预训练语料，用拓扑感知 Transformer 跨市场元训练，使单一与区域数无关的参数集可适配未见电网。在美国五个 ISO 的无泄漏基准上，各模型输入统一为价格、日前负荷预测与日历特征，MetaGrid 取得最低平均 MAE，较最佳基线降低 3.1%，较同架构从零训练降低 7.7%。
arxiv.reason: 电价预测属能源垂直应用，仅沾元学习与 Transformer 边

arxiv.title: Measure Neural Mappings
arxiv.abstract: We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. These self-attention transformers are MNMs under the stated assumptions: pre-norm architectures follow from compact stability after normalization, while post-norm architectures are covered under the stated tail conditions. We prove corresponding cross-attention estimates and extend the results to multihead attention and grouped transformer evaluation, with convergence as the group size grows. For Set Transformers viewed as measure-to-vector mappings, we obtain an $N^{-1/2}$ bound on the expected Euclidean output error under the stated assumptions. Experiments on seven operators in dimensions $d=1,2,3,5,10$ support the predicted particle-count dependence, using one-dimensional Wasserstein computations and Sinkhorn approximations in higher dimensions. The observed Wasserstein and sliced Wasserstein decay rates are close to their respective theoretical sampling benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 测度神经映射
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出并定义测度神经映射(MNM)，将依赖测度的神经传输与集合一致性结合，用于在概率测度上学习算子;集合一致性要求从输入分布采样、规模不断增大的集合，其输出依概率收敛到指定总体输出。在强次高斯与尾部可积假设下，为注意力建立了定量连续极限，证明固定自注意力 Transformer 的期望输出 Wasserstein 误差由经验输入 Wasserstein 误差加上一个 N^{-1/2} 注意力项界定。进一步给出交叉注意力、多头注意力与分组 Transformer 的相应估计(随组规模增长收敛)，并对视作测度到向量映射的 Set Transformer 得到 N^{-1/2} 欧氏误差界。在 d=1,2,3,5,10 上对七类算子的实验支持所预测的粒子数依赖，低维用一维 Wasserstein、高维用 Sinkhorn 近似，观测到的 Wasserstein 与切片 Wasserstein 衰减率接近各自理论采样基准。
arxiv.reason: 注意力连续极限与 Transformer 测度理论，命中架构方向但偏纯数学

arxiv.title: Variable Input Masked Autoencoders for Wrist-Worn Accelerometry
arxiv.abstract: Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior. However, existing models are pretrained using fixed input durations and sampling rates, despite substantial heterogeneity in recording conditions, downstream tasks, and deployment constraints. We introduce VarMAE, a variable input masked autoencoder that learns a single representation across sampling rates and temporal contexts. During pretraining we construct two views of the same signal: a long duration high frequency view, and a short duration lower frequency view, obtained via random cropping and downsampling. We perform masked reconstruction within each view and introduce a cross-resolution masked reconstruction objective that uses visible tokens from the long view to predict masked tokens from the short view. Cropping and downsampling impose complementary information bottlenecks, encouraging the model to learn representations that remain effective across input durations and sampling rate changes. We pretrain VarMAE on the large-scale NHANES dataset, producing a single pretrained encoder matching or outperforming controlled foundation model baselines on eight benchmark datasets. With only 3.82M parameters, VarMAE is parameter efficient and shows that a single foundation model can achieve broad transfer capabilities across sensing configurations.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于腕戴式加速度计数据的可变输入掩码自编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 可穿戴传感器基础模型多以固定输入时长与采样率预训练，难以适配记录条件、下游任务与部署约束的异构性。VarMAE 在预训练时用随机裁剪与下采样构造同一信号的两个视图——长时长高频视图与短时长低频视图，在各视图内做掩码重建，并引入跨分辨率掩码重建目标，用长视图的可见 token 预测短视图的被掩码 token，以互补信息瓶颈迫使表示在时长与采样率变化下依然有效。基于大规模 NHANES 数据预训练，单一编码器在 8 个基准数据集上持平或超越受控基础模型基线，参数量仅 3.82M，表明单一基础模型可覆盖多种传感配置。
arxiv.reason: 可穿戴传感自监督预训练，与 LLM 关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Mitigating Black-Box Score-Based Query Attacks via Gradient Confusion
arxiv.abstract: Score-based black-box adversarial attacks pose a serious threat to deployed machine learning systems by exploiting repeated model queries to craft adversarial examples, requiring neither access to model parameters nor architecture. Existing defenses predominantly rely on stochastic output perturbations, which fail to prevent determined attackers from recovering stable gradient estimates by increasing query budgets or averaging over randomness. In this work, we propose the Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD), a retraining-free, deterministic test-time wrapper that actively shapes the probability vector returned to querying adversaries. By solving a constrained optimization problem grounded in the model's Jacobian, GCD aligns the exposed logit-gradient with a target confusion direction that is maximally misaligned with the true adversarial loss gradient---increasing the query complexity of attacks without sacrificing predictive utility or top-1 accuracy. We provide rigorous theoretical analysis demonstrating that GCD provably slows gradient-estimation-based attacks and induces systematic accept/reject errors in random search-based attacks, with the confusion effect amplifying as the fraction of defended queries increases. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet across multiple architectures (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16) and four state-of-the-art attacks confirm these predictions: GCD achieves state-of-the-art robustness, while incurring zero clean accuracy degradation. %Crucially, unlike randomization-based defenses, GCD's deterministic structure provides resilience against adaptive attacks that exploit stochasticity, making it well-suited for security-critical deployment settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过梯度混淆缓解黑盒基于分数的查询攻击
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击，现有防御依赖随机输出扰动，攻击者可通过增大查询预算或多次平均恢复稳定的梯度估计。GCD 是免重训练的确定性测试时封装，通过求解基于模型雅可比的约束优化问题，把暴露给攻击者的 logit 梯度对齐到与真实对抗损失梯度最大错位的混淆方向，从而提高攻击的查询复杂度。理论分析证明它能减慢基于梯度估计的攻击，并在随机搜索攻击中引入系统性的接受／拒绝错误，防御查询占比越高混淆效应越强。在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet 上对 ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16 及四种 SOTA 攻击取得最优鲁棒性，干净精度零下降。
arxiv.reason: 对抗鲁棒性防御，与 LLM 后训练／Agent 主线无关

arxiv.title: Robustly Reliable Learning for Regression
arxiv.abstract: We introduce the problem of robustly reliable learning for the regression setting in adversarial environments. Given a test point $x_{test}$, a training dataset $S$ of $n$ data points, a corruption budget $b \ll n$, and a real-valued hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, our goal is to output the optimal prediction range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$, such that any $L$-Lipschitz predictor consistent with all but at most $b$ points in $S$ must predict a value $h(x_{test}) \in I$. We then instantiate the analysis for $L$-Lipschitz hypothesis classes, a natural and widely studied class in the regression setting, focusing on two key scenarios. First, for the restricted case where the corrupted dataset is guaranteed to be $L$-Lipschitz consistent, we propose a simple and efficient $b^{th}$-best heuristic algorithm and prove its correctness in computing the tightest possible range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$. We then establish its computational complexity of $O(n)$ and show that it is computationally optimal in this scenario. Building on this foundation, we address the general scenario where the dataset $S$ is no longer $L$-Lipschitz consistent. We demonstrate that computing the optimal range in this setting reduces to analyzing a violation graph, which models the pairwise $L$-Lipschitz violations among data points. By leveraging the structural properties of this graph's kernel, we propose a Fixed-Parameter Tractable (FPT) algorithm that computes the exact optimal range in $O(n^2 + b^4)$ time. Furthermore, under the Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis (SETH), we establish a computational lower bound of $Ω(n^{2 - o(1)})$, proving that our algorithm is computationally optimal. Finally, we discuss open directions for the problem of robustly reliable learning for regression.
arxiv.titleZh: 回归场景下的鲁棒可靠学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对对抗环境下的回归问题提出「鲁棒可靠学习」:给定测试点、n 个训练样本、损坏预算 b 与实值假设类 H，要求输出最优预测区间 I*，使任何与 S 中至多 b 个点不一致的 L-Lipschitz 预测器在测试点的取值必落在该区间内。对受限情形(损坏数据仍满足 L-Lipschitz 相容)给出第 b 优的启发式算法，证明其能算出最紧区间，复杂度 O(n) 且在该情形下计算最优。对一般情形，把最优区间求解归约为刻画样本点两两 Lipschitz 违背的违例图，借助其核的结构性质给出 O(n^2+b^4) 的 FPT 算法，并在 SETH 下证明 Ω(n^{2-o(1)}) 下界。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论与经典回归鲁棒性分析，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics, and the generator produces new heuristics with this insight. These improvements join the preference pairs for direct preference optimization (DPO). Since DPO only teaches the generator to rank these improvements, a reflective self-distillation (RSD) term makes it more likely to generate them on its own, and the gains accumulate over the long horizon of the search. Across COPs and open-source LLM backbones, EPOCH's heuristic ensembles outperform inference-only and fine-tuned baselines and generalize across problem scales.
arxiv.titleZh: EPOCH:面向基于LLM的自动启发式设计的覆盖感知演化与经验偏好优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基于LLM的自动启发式设计或冻结生成器，或仅用标量适应度微调，丢失了启发式覆盖哪些实例的信息;反思式框架的自然语言反馈也只留在提示里，进不到生成器权重。EPOCH把实例覆盖作为演化搜索目标，父代选择、算子分配与停滞恢复共同优化启发式对训练实例的联合覆盖，得到互补的启发式集成;并用经验偏好优化让生成器从自身搜索中学习:教师LLM针对生成的启发式给出自然语言洞见，生成器据此产出新启发式，两者组成偏好对做DPO，再加反思式自蒸馏项提高自主生成此类改进的概率。在多个组合优化问题与开源LLM主干上，所得集成优于仅推理与微调基线，并可跨问题规模泛化。
arxiv.reason: DPO+反思自蒸馏做自进化，方法擦边后训练但落点是组合优化垂直应用

arxiv.title: Get In, Decide, Prove: A Merchant-Side Readiness Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
arxiv.abstract: AI agents now browse and buy on people's behalf, and benchmarks measure how well the agents perform. Far less is known about the other side of the transaction: whether a merchant's website lets an agent in, publishes terms precise enough to decide a purchase, and leaves evidence of what was agreed. This paper presents a merchant-side benchmark built on those three questions and reports a pilot of it. The central measurement, decision sufficiency, rates each criterion of a concrete buyer mandate (total cost, cancellation or return terms, service date, variant identity) as determinate, indeterminate, or unknown from the merchant's own published evidence. Readiness scores carry their evidence coverage and missingness bounds; access is reported separately for a declared bot, a declared headless browser, and a user-present browser; and each observed term is mapped to the RAILS admissibility class of the evidence that could support it in a dispute. Four large merchants received the full assessment: three refused the declared profiles at their offer pages, and no mandate could be confirmed as met, because each merchant left a total or a refund term undetermined. An access census of 555 sites of merchants that two payment processors publicly name as clients found the home page unreadable to both declared profiles at 105 sites (18.9%). A declared assessment of 330 merchants, scored by deterministic rules without a rater, found that evidence coverage rather than the score decides who can be ranked: 115 merchants (35%) reached the ranking threshold, rankable profiles scored a median of 89 to 90, and material terms was the one pillar well below the others, because the all-in total was decidable at 18 merchants. The pilot shows that the measurements can be taken; it does not validate them or rank merchants, and the weights and the projected clearing band await validation against outcomes.

arxiv.titleZh: 进得来、可决策、能举证:面向 Agentic Commerce 的商家侧就绪度基准

arxiv.title: What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs
arxiv.abstract: A shared latent space is often assumed to make representations from different schemas directly interchangeable, yet sharing parameters, dimensionality, or a prior does not determine how corresponding instances are expressed in latent coordinates. We show that this assumption conflates recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse. In a controlled multi-schema motion VAE on HumanML3D, even identical inputs yield only $5.9$--$17.7\%$ raw Recall@1 and $0.221$--$0.484$ paired-token cosine, despite correspondence being almost perfectly recoverable after linear calibration. Cycle consistency strengthens recoverability but still leaves direct retrieval and token agreement near zero. In contrast, only $64$ paired clips raise raw Recall@1 to $88.4$--$90.3\%$ and token cosine to approximately $0.82$, making most post-hoc alignment unnecessary, although crossed decoding remains substantially worse than native reconstruction. We further find that reducing measured marginal discrepancy does not imply schema invariance. These results show that a shared backbone or prior does not ensure directly compatible latent coordinates, while limited paired correspondence can substantially improve direct compatibility in the tested setting.
arxiv.titleZh: 什么使潜空间得以共享？运动 VAE 中的直接兼容性与可恢复兼容性
arxiv.summaryZh: 在多 schema 的运动 VAE 受控实验（HumanML3D）中，共享参数、维度或先验并不能保证对应实例在潜坐标中可直接互换：即使输入完全相同，原始 Recall@1 仅 5.9%–17.7%，配对 token 余弦相似度 0.221–0.484，而经线性校准后对应关系几乎可完美恢复。循环一致性提升可恢复性，却仍让直接检索与 token 一致性接近零；仅 64 对配对片段即可把原始 Recall@1 提到 88.4%–90.3%、token 余弦约 0.82，使多数事后对齐变得多余，但交叉解码仍明显弱于原生重建。降低测得的边缘分布差异也不等于 schema 不变性。

arxiv.title: PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.
arxiv.titleZh: PIG：并行不一致性引导加速扩散语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型通过单次前向并行解码多个掩码位置来加速，但并行轨迹偏离慢速的顺序生成oracle时准确率会下降。PIG用约2M参数的轻量辅助模型在单次前向中估计并行与顺序生成的不一致程度，推理时按置信度递减遍历掩码位置，逐个将token加入并行解码集，直至累计不一致超过阈值。该辅助模型仅需在OpenCoder、GSM8K-train、MATH-train与MBPP-train的小规模混合数据上训练。在LLaDA-8B Instruct与NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct上，PIG在GSM8K、MATH500、MBPP、HumanEval、MMLU上超越Fast-dLLM的准确率-TPF前沿，并胜过DAPD、KLASS、EB-sampler等解掩码策略。

arxiv.title: HarnessTTT: Learn to Optimize Harness at Test-Time for Scientific Discovery
arxiv.abstract: Scientific discovery with language models requires finding the best valid solution within a finite computational budget. We study how feedback from this search can improve the procedure used to conduct it. We introduce HarnessTTT, a test-time learning framework that trains a harness proposer while keeping the executor frozen. The proposer generates executable harnesses comprising system prompts, reusable skills, tools, middleware, and execution controls. Each harness guides a budgeted discovery rollout, whose outcome provides feedback for updating the proposer. A discovery-oriented policy-gradient objective combines gap-normalized rewards, leave-one-out advantages (RLOO), and max-sharpening to favor high-performing proposals. Generated components are validated before execution, and the search retains the best valid solution and selected harnesses across rounds. Across fourteen discovery tasks in mathematics, systems, GPU kernels, heuristic programming, astrodynamics, and biology, HarnessTTT with a frozen 9B executor improves on OpenEvolve with the same executor on all eleven benchmark tasks (e.g., from 1.17 to 2.64 on circle packing), improves on the discovery-fine-tuned Finch-9B by up to 92%, holds the best open-weight sub-10B result on nine, and reaches 0.380919 on Erdős minimum overlap, better than the best human reference of 0.380927. Scaling the proposer and frozen executor to 27B improves on eleven of fourteen tasks, and transferring the learned harnesses to GPT-5.5 matches or exceeds the strongest reported system of any backbone on nine of fourteen tasks. Together, these results show that harness search can itself be learned at test time: a trained proposer lets a small frozen executor search effectively, and the harnesses it finds carry over to stronger executors.

arxiv.titleZh: HarnessTTT: 在测试时学习优化 Harness 以进行科学发现

arxiv.title: HASTE: Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for Generative Recommendation
arxiv.abstract: Generative recommendation models have shown promising results by representing items as semantic IDs and generating these IDs autoregressively. We introduce an approach showing that explicitly incorporating hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into generative recommendation can simultaneously improve training efficiency and long-tail recommendation performance. Existing approaches typically optimize semantic ID prediction with a standard causal cross-entropy objective, which does not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure of semantic IDs and can require substantial training to learn effective item representations. Moreover, data-sparse tail items often suffer from poor representations due to limited supervision, resulting in weaker long-tail recommendation performance. We address these challenges with HASTE (Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for generaTive rEcommendation), a unified training framework that introduces hierarchical and attribute-specific supervision. HASTE's Hierarchical Loss explicitly exploits the multi-level structure of semantic IDs, providing supervision at each level of the item hierarchy and substantially accelerating training convergence. Its Attribute-Specific Losses encourage the model to preserve fine-grained item attributes, leveraging the language model's inherent semantic knowledge to improve representations and recommendations for tail items. We extensively evaluate HASTE on a fashion recommendation benchmark and across multiple domains of the Amazon dataset. HASTE improves recommendation performance across datasets and item-frequency regimes. Notably, the Hierarchical Loss achieves approximately 2x faster convergence than the standard causal cross-entropy objective, substantially improving training efficiency while maintaining strong recommendation quality.
arxiv.titleZh: HASTE：面向生成式推荐的分层与属性感知监督
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式推荐把物品表示为 semantic ID 并自回归生成，但标准因果交叉熵未利用 semantic ID 的层级结构，且长尾物品因监督稀疏而表征较差。HASTE 提出统一训练框架：分层损失在物品层级的每一级施加监督，属性特定损失促使模型保留细粒度物品属性并借助语言模型固有语义知识改善尾部物品表征。在时尚推荐基准与 Amazon 多领域数据集上，HASTE 在各数据域和物品频次区间均提升推荐效果，其中分层损失收敛速度约为标准因果交叉熵的 2 倍。

arxiv.title: When Goals Leak Across Relationships: How Cached Goal Representations Shape Cross-Client Decisions
arxiv.abstract: As LLM agents take on more autonomous roles, they may interact with multiple clients and counterparties whose goals and incentives conflict. If an agent maintains shared inference state across these interactions, information associated with one relationship may influence decisions made for another. We test OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in a controlled two-client environment with 20 market scenarios, where each client is assigned an opposing objective. With shared conversational memory, the model deviates from the current client's objective in 22% of eligible decisions. We then investigate how these goals are represented in the KV cache. Linear probes show that client-goal ownership becomes highly recoverable in middle layers and is concentrated in particular attention heads. We use these results to identify where to intervene in the cache and test whether these representations affect the model's decisions. Ablating the competitor's cached goal representations at these locations shifts the model toward the current client. The effect is larger for heads identified by probing than for randomly selected heads, and larger when ablating goal tokens than matched non-goal tokens from the same client. Our results show that client-specific goal representations persist in the KV cache and can causally influence decisions made for other clients, highlighting the importance of relationship-specific state isolation in persistent LLM agents.

arxiv.title: UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
arxiv.abstract: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.
arxiv.titleZh: UMCR:通过指南集成与智能体链接实现通用医学概念识别
arxiv.summaryZh: 医学概念识别要把医学文本中的片段抽取出来并链接到标准本体条目，但现有方法通常只面向单一本体与单一文本类型，换本体往往需要重新训练。UMCR 用一条统一流水线把目标本体的指南信息直接注入提示，并加入智能体链接模块，从而适配任意目标本体和任意来源文本。在覆盖多种医学文本类型与词表的 MedPath 基准上均取得较好表现，同时相比既有做法更少依赖 LLM 的参数化记忆。其价值在于支持不同医疗标准之间的抽取与对齐，提升医疗领域互操作性。

arxiv.title: claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness
arxiv.abstract: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.
arxiv.titleZh: claimcheck：度量并提升规约忠实性
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 越来越多地同时编写代码与形式化规约，但形式验证只证明程序满足规约，不保证规约符合作者意图；比需求更窄的规约即使被证明也毫无价值。为量化这一鸿沟，构建了覆盖 Dafny、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq 四种语言、共 3234 条的规约形式化 benchmark，每条配对自然语言需求与形式化产物及标签，其中三分之一为保持语义的改写。工具 claimcheck 先让未见需求的模型把产物回译为英文，再由独立 judge 判断回译与需求是否表达同一保证，四种语言上宏平均召回较单次调用高 8.2–9.8 个点，增益随 judge 增强而收窄至 1 个点以内。

arxiv.title: On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention
arxiv.abstract: We revisit the statistical mechanics of Transformer attention via modern Hopfield models. We present a free-energy formalism to characterize parameter regimes and critical thresholds for robust attention inference. The resulting free-energy landscape incorporates randomness in query states and attention weights. Attention then emerges as the equation of motion of the corresponding statistical-mechanical system (i.e., modern Hopfield model) through the standard free-energy minimization principle. This allows us to identify first-order phase transitions in attention between glassy and robust-inference phases. We further extend to attentions with stochastic queries and keys. Together, our results provide a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for characterizing phase structure and inference reliability across a family of Transformer attention mechanisms.
arxiv.titleZh: 论注意力的统计力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对Transformer注意力推理可靠性缺乏理论刻画的问题，借助现代Hopfield模型给出自由能形式化框架，将注意力表述为统计力学系统的运动方程，并把query状态与注意力权重的随机性纳入其中。分析揭示注意力在玻璃相与鲁棒推理相之间存在一阶相变，给出对应的参数区间与临界阈值，并进一步推广到query与key随机的情形。该框架为一系列注意力变体的相结构与推理可靠性提供统一的统计力学分析工具。

arxiv.title: Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts
arxiv.abstract: Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Across five models, SUR achieves strong recovery in controlled deletion tasks while recomputing only 2-5% of the suffix. On four natural multi-hop QA datasets, it achieves near-full-recompute exact match at a 5% budget with lower post-edit latency. The executor accelerates fragmented refresh by up to 16.1x over interval-wise execution.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向演化上下文的预算受限 KV-Cache 修复
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型 Agent 会随信息过时改写工作上下文，但删除文本无法抹去其对已缓存计算的残留影响:后续 KV 状态仍条件于被删内容，而重算整段保留后缀代价高昂。作者提出预算受限的 KV-Cache 修复，只重算保留后缀中用户指定比例的 token;在相同相关性分数与 token 预算下，刷新连贯文本区域显著优于刷新孤立 token，据此设计 Semantic-Unit Refresh(SUR)，用廉价 embedding 分数把预算分给与查询相关的文本区域，无需训练或额外前向，并由 layer-packed executor 在每层批量处理所选状态、同时保留完整因果 cache 访问。五个模型上仅重算 2–5% 后缀即获得强恢复;四个多跳 QA 数据集上以 5% 预算接近全量重算的 exact match，且后编辑延迟更低，执行器较逐区间执行最高加速 16.1×。

arxiv.title: COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration
arxiv.abstract: Vision large language models (VLLMs) are deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising training-data exposure concerns. Existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly generation with limited membership separation. Perturbation-based methods instead measure response changes but focus on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. We systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across noise levels at fine resolution. We find that optimal perturbation magnitude and membership-signal direction vary across model-dataset pairs. In many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime yields stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members, reversing the conventional score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. We propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Renyi-normalized KL divergence and Renyi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5-7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS outperforms baselines. On general-domain data, COMPASS achieves AUCs up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.
arxiv.titleZh: COMPASS:通过自适应噪声校准对视觉大语言模型的成员推断攻击
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对视觉大语言模型训练数据暴露风险，现有灰盒成员推断攻击依赖熵统计或生成描述、开销大且区分度有限，而基于扰动的方法只关注大扰动。COMPASS 在细粒度高斯噪声下系统刻画成员行为，发现最优扰动幅度与成员信号方向随模型-数据集对变化，低噪声区甚至出现成员发散度更低的反向信号;方法用分布大致匹配的已知非成员参考集自适应校准扰动幅度与打分方向，并以 Renyi 归一化 KL/Renyi 散度配合图像 logit 位置的 max-k 聚合实现。在 LLaVA v1.5-7B、MiniGPT-4、HuluMed-32B 上覆盖预训练、指令微调与医学图像数据，通用域 AUC 最高 0.88，分布匹配的医学评测达 0.64 而最强基线仅随机水平。

arxiv.title: Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean
arxiv.abstract: General-purpose coding agents use standard shell and file interactions, yet formal theorem-proving agents often rely on specialized, ad-hoc tooling. This makes it difficult to determine which components of theorem-proving agents provide benchmark gains: an improved base model, a specialized harness, a specific tool, or a combination of any of them. We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash. The model must use bash to inspect and edit the repository, search local libraries, invoke Lean, and manage its own intermediate work, while a separate trusted evaluator verifies the final artifact. We compare mini-Lean-agent against AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent on the Putnam 2025 benchmark. Experiments with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the base model show that mini-Lean-agent solves 7/12 problems at \$2 per problem limit, compared with AxProverBase's 4/12. With Astra as the base model, mini-Lean-agent solves 12/12 problems at an average cost of \$1.28 per problem. This suggests that a generic coding agent with a minimal harness can already achieve strong performance on Lean benchmarks. Our results motivate using mini-Lean-agent as a standard baseline when evaluating theorem-proving infrastructure.

arxiv.titleZh: 定理证明器需要定理证明智能体吗?mini-Lean-agent:面向 Lean 的编码智能体基线
arxiv.summaryZh: 形式化定理证明智能体普遍依赖专用定制的工具链，导致难以分辨性能提升来自基座模型、专用 harness 还是某个特定工具。mini-Lean-agent 把这件事压到最小:模型可见的唯一工具就是 bash，检查与修改仓库、检索本地库、调用 Lean、管理中间产物全部通过 bash 完成，最终产物交由独立的可信评估器验证。在 Putnam 2025 基准上，以 Gemini 3.8 Flash 为基座时在每题 2 美元预算下解出 7/12，高于 AxProverBase 的 4/12;换成 Astra 基座则 12/12 全解，平均每题 1.28 美元。结果表明通用编码智能体配极简 harness 已足以在 Lean 任务上取得强表现，可作为评估定理证明基础设施的标准基线。

arxiv.title: The Curse of Knowledge in Role-Playing Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Role-playing language models speak as characters in games and agent simulations, where the system records what each character can hear, see and understand. We test whether characters respect these boundaries in 480 scenes, each with a counterfactual twin that changes only the hidden fact, so mentions of the twin's fact measure guessing. Across 11 open-weight models, characters use content from speech they cannot understand or hear at 67 and 72 percentage points (pp) above this baseline, although most models correctly state what the character perceives. This is a curse of knowledge. The leak extends to hidden actions and private messages and changes where characters search. Five of six proprietary models rarely leak, but compliance in strong models depends on input format. Changing only the scene layout or character description raises the rate in two otherwise compliant open-weight models from under 10 to over 60 pp, and combined changes raise two proprietary models from near zero to 13 and 21~pp. Writing the line as the scene's author leaks nearly as much as role-play, and thinking rarely helps. Giving models only what the character observes stops the leak without hiding what it may report.
arxiv.titleZh: 角色扮演语言模型中的知识诅咒
arxiv.summaryZh: 角色扮演语言模型需按角色实际能看到、听到和理解的信息行动。研究用 480 个场景及其只改动隐藏事实的对照孪生来测量模型是否猜出隐藏信息：11 个开源权重模型的角色引用了听不到或听不懂的内容，分别高出基线 67 和 72 个百分点，而多数模型却能正确陈述角色感知到什么。泄漏同样出现在隐藏动作与私信上并改变角色的搜索行为；六分之五的闭源模型很少泄漏，但仅改写场景布局或角色描述就能让原本合规的模型从不足 10 pp 升到 60 pp 以上。只向模型提供角色可观察的信息即可消除泄漏，说明缺陷来自输入范围的界定而非感知能力不足。

arxiv.title: Thinking Outside the Bots: Human Ideas in AI's Semantic Blind Spots Are Not Inferior
arxiv.abstract: AI-generated outputs are frequently perceived as highly creative, but also tend to be more similar to each other (homogenized) than human ideas. Does the human heterogeneity that extends beyond AI reflect valuable thinking that AI misses? Alternatively, is greater human heterogeneity driven by lower-quality ideas and less effective thinking that AI avoids? We developed Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression (EDGE) to map AI's semantic "blind spots" by assessing how strongly/weakly individual human ideas were represented in a task-matched AI semantic comparison set. Specifically, we compared human-generated vs. AI-generated ideas across three open-ended tasks: college admissions essays, alternative uses for everyday objects, and interpersonal advice. Across all three tasks, human responses extended into semantic regions sparsely covered by AI outputs. These distinctively human responses showed no meaningful deficits in creativity, quality, or effectiveness, were associated with equal-or-better academic performance, and with credibly superior ratings and achievement for some outcomes. These ideas were thus not merely poor-performing variation; they performed as well as or better than ideas that overlapped more strongly with AI ideas. More distinctive human ideas tended to receive higher creativity ratings, but this relationship was weak or reversed for AI ideas. Taken together, these results suggest that differentiation among human-generated ideas does not reflect poor thinking that AI can safely omit, and instead may afford both individual and population-level advantages.
arxiv.titleZh: 跳出机器思维：AI 语义盲区中的人类想法并不逊色
arxiv.summaryZh: AI 生成内容常被认为富有创造力，却比人类想法更同质化。为检验人类异质性究竟是 AI 遗漏的有价值思考、还是低质量变异，研究提出 EDGE（Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression），将个体人类想法映射到任务匹配的 AI 语义比较集中，衡量其落入 AI 语义盲区的强弱。在申请文书、日常物品替代用途、人际建议三类开放任务上，人类回答均延伸至 AI 覆盖稀疏的语义区域，其创造力、质量与有效性无显著劣势，部分评分与学业表现反而更优；人类想法越独特创造力评分越高，AI 想法则关系微弱甚至反转。这说明人类想法的分化并非可被 AI 安全省略的低质量思考，而是兼具个体与群体层面价值的来源。

arxiv.title: Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Stochastic optimization models sequential decision-making under uncertainty, typically assuming known input distributions. When these distributions are unknown, \citet{agarwal2026semibandit} give an online-to-offline reduction for monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, where only probed variables are observed. Its expected regret relative to the offline guarantee is $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$, where $n$ is the number of variables and $T$ the horizon. For optimal stopping and Pandora's box, \citet{liu2025improved} achieve $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ using problem-specific algorithms. \emph{Can a general online-to-offline reduction achieve this improved rate?} We give such a reduction for strongly monotone stochastic optimization, answering the corresponding open question. Strong monotonicity is defined relative to the chosen offline algorithm. Our oracle-efficient reduction achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ expected regret while preserving approximation guarantees for oracles satisfying the same condition. It combines Bernstein-type optimistic distribution estimates with a Hellinger stability bound for adaptive policy transcripts, aggregating squared marginal errors weighted by the executed policy's probing probabilities. The rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors for $T\ge n$, even under full feedback. Under monotonicity and uniformly bounded coordinate-wise variation, the same algorithm achieves $\widetilde O(n^{3/4}\sqrt T)$ expected approximation regret, improving the previous linear dependence on $n$. The exponent $3/4$ is sharp for its ordinary regret over instances and exact oracle choices. Our framework applies to prophet inequality, Pandora's box, best-of-$K$ selection, stochastic knapsack, stochastic orienteering, and stochastic submodular maximization.
arxiv.titleZh: 半强盗反馈下单调随机优化的近最优遗憾界
arxiv.summaryZh: 未知输入分布下的单调随机优化中，此前通用 online-to-offline 归约的期望遗憾为 Õ(n√T)，而最优停止、Pandora's box 等问题专用算法可达 Õ(√nT)，通用归约能否达到该速率此前未决。本文针对相对所选离线算法定义的强单调性构造 oracle 高效归约，以 Bernstein 型乐观分布估计配合自适应策略轨迹的 Hellinger 稳定性界，按执行策略的探测概率加权聚合边际误差平方。该归约取得 Õ(√nT) 期望遗憾并保持近似保证，在 T≥n 时对数因子内最优;在坐标逐项变化一致有界下近似遗憾为 Õ(n^{3/4}√T)，改善了此前对 n 的线性依赖。框架覆盖 prophet inequality、Pandora's box、best-of-K 选择、随机背包与随机子模最大化。

arxiv.title: From Sampled Evidence to Radiology Reports: Objectives, Constraints, and Realization
arxiv.abstract: Sampling multiple reports creates an inference problem: how should sampled evidence be converted into a final decision, and does a better structured decision yield a better report? We study these questions through a framework that separates the decision signal, scoring objective, and feasible decision set, followed by text realization. On MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray, controlled comparisons across 13 generator configurations per benchmark under grouped development/test evaluation reveal three findings. First, changing the objective under fixed evidence and rule capacity changes predictions and their held-out metric trade-offs. Second, relaxing candidate constraints has objective-dependent effects under shared signals and frozen scores. Diagnostics connect the IU macro-oriented assertion increase to near-zero label thresholds and show that limited candidate coverage coexists with selection headroom. Third, a controlled realization study with SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B shows that decision-level gains can be attenuated, amplified, or reversed. Change decomposition reveals that realization can remove incorrect assertions while losing correct findings, so target fidelity and reference accuracy need not improve together. Finding gains also do not consistently improve reference-based report quality. These results motivate separate evaluation of decision rules, candidate constraints, and realized reports.
arxiv.titleZh: 从采样证据到放射学报告：目标、约束与实现
arxiv.summaryZh: 多份采样报告如何汇聚为最终决策、结构化决策能否带来更好报告，是放射报告生成中的推理难题。该工作把决策信号、评分目标与可行决策集分离，再交由文本实现模块生成报告，在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU-Xray 上按分组开发/测试集比较 13 种生成器配置。结果显示：证据与规则容量固定时改变目标会改变预测及留出指标权衡，放宽候选约束的影响依赖目标；用 SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B 的实现实验表明决策层收益可能被削弱、放大甚至反转，实现会删掉错误断言同时丢失正确发现。结论是决策规则、候选约束与最终报告应分开评估。
